title: Director, Research
description:
Job Title

Director, Research

Agency

Texas A&M University System Offices

Department

Texas A&M Semiconductor Institute

Proposed Minimum Salary

Commensurate

Job Location

Bryan, Texas

Job Type

Staff

Job Description

The System Offices is one of several system members within the Texas A&M University System representing one of the largest systems of higher education in the nation, with a network of 12 universities, a comprehensive health science center, eight state agencies, Texas A&M – Fort Worth and the Texas A&M - RELLIS Campus. The Texas A&M University System mission is to provide education, conduct research, commercialize technology, offer training, and deliver services for the people of Texas and beyond.

The System Offices, within the Texas A&M University System, provides an outstanding benefits package including, but not limited to: competitive health benefits; paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays; a defined benefit retirement plan to include an employer contribution through Teachers Retirement System of Texas (TRS); if applicable, a defined contribution retirement plan to include an employer contribution through an approved ORP vendor: additional voluntary tax deferred annuity (TDA) options; tuition assistance; and wellness programs to promote work/life balance.


Salary:

Commensurate with experience.

Job Description Summary:

The Director, Research of the Texas A&M Semiconductor Institute has full technical responsibility for planning, directing, and serving as the Principal Investigator for the Institute. With a primary focus on quantum photonics, Al, and advanced semiconductor technologies, the Director, Research will harness the collaborative research strengths of The Texas A&M University System to identify external and internal research opportunities. The CRO and Director is responsible for leading efforts to identify, hire and on-board requisite talent to achieve TSI research objectives. As a research leader, the Director will lead and partner amongst university, consortia, industry and government affiliates to spearhead industry and government relevant research supporting development and coordination of the TSI research vectors.


Responsibilities:

- As an individual contributor, leads and directs research projects in quantum photonics, serving as Principal Investigator.

- Coordinates research and development activities across disciplines, this involves exploration of subject area, definition of scope and selection of problems for investigation, and development of novel concepts and approaches in technical areas.

- Contributes as a distinguished quantum photonics and semiconductor process expert to build a research portfolio both within TSI as well as in partnership with others that advances semiconductor research addressing key challenges in quantum technologies and advanced node wafer processing.

- Collaborates with partners to develop and implement new and/or expanded technical capabilities in quantum photonics that will impact future research projects; provides the organization with a distinct competitive advantage in procuring funding.

- Stays abreast of new technical methods and developments affecting quantum photonics and semiconductor research for the purpose of recommending changes in emphasis of programs or new programs warranted by such developments.

- Fosters partnerships with key stakeholders in the quantum technology ecosystem, including other research institutions, industry leaders, and government agencies.

- In a supervisory capacity, plans, develops, coordinates, and directs several large and significant projects or a project of major scope and importance.

- May be responsible for an entire scientific and/or engineering program when the program is of limited complexity and scope.

- Plans, organizes, and supervises the work of a staff of scientists, engineers, and technicians.

- Evaluates progress of the staff and results obtained and recommends major changes to achieve overall objectives.

- Defines staffing needs, selection/ assessment criteria, and hiring process for research/engineering staff.

- Identifies, proposes and leads new strategies/initiatives that are critical to the Institute; guides programs of national or international significance.

- Presents papers, joins panels, and chairs committees; participates on advisory/policy boards, journals and societies; serves as peer reviewer of major technical programs; networks nationally and internationally.

- Leads the development and implementation of new and/or expanded technical capabilities that will impact future research projects; provides the organization with a distinct competitive advantage in procuring funding.

- Typically directs and/or participates in major proposal preparation and presentation.

- Works collaboratively with other Institute Directors to ensure alignment or programs and research.

- Performs other related duties as assigned.


Education and Experience:

- PhD. degree in applicable field (e.g., Physics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or related field.

- Twelve years of related experience, with at least eight years in a research setting or an industrial semiconductor setting.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

- Strong supervisory and team building skills

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Strong interpersonal, leadership, organizational and customer service skills

- Strong analytical, problem solving and organizational skills

- Sound judgement

- Knowledge of word processing, spreadsheet, and database applications.

- Demonstrated expertise in quantum photonics, AI, and advanced semiconductor technologies.

- Ability to multi-task and work cooperatively with others.


Preferred Qualifications:

- Strong background in quantum photonics.

- Experience applying for public grants related to quantum technologies or semiconductor research.

- Experience working for defense and/or other government contracting in quantum and photonics fields.

- Track record of successful collaborations with national laboratories and industry partners.


Other Requirements:

This is a security-sensitive position and is restricted to U.S. citizens and legal permanent residents only. Only complete applications will be considered for employment at The Texas A&M System Offices. Incomplete job application data could result in your application being rejected without an option to reapply. A cover letter and resume may be required in addition to a completed employment application.

title: Policy Lead, Global Policy and Standards, Monetization
description:
Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

This role is on the Monetized product policy team, a part of the Trust and Safety, Global Policy and Standards team. The role focuses on policy development for Google’s ads policies that address scams & deceptive marketing.

As a Product Policy Specialist, you will advise internal Google teams on core principles, design policies and standards to address abuse risks, and enable responsible growth. In addition, you will engage with subject matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders across Google to design thoughtful cross-prodcut area approaches on key priorities. As an independent, critical thinker, you will bring the investigative excellence to translate intricate problems into scalable solutions at defining precise standards for evolving areas of tech policy. You will balance the legal and regulatory requirements we face around the world with the needs of users, advertisers, creators and publishers, while upholding the company’s core values.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $164000 - $239000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Anticipate policy issues facing product and technology platforms and develop policies and enforcement recommendations on how to address them.
  • Lead, develop, and implement policies for Google products, with a view towards user safety and product quality.
  • Influence product decisions and prioritization and improve user experience for policy-related issues through collaboration with Product Managers, Engineers, and other Trust and Safety teams.
  • Drive awareness and understanding of our product policies within Google and across our user base through research to set industry standards.
  • Be exposed to graphic, controversial, or upsetting content.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in a policy, legal, Trust and Safety, or technology environment.

Preferred qualifications:

  • JD, MBA or Master’s degree in a technical field.
  • Experience in policy in the technology sector and key tech policy issues (e.g., privacy, safety, artificial intelligence, content moderation).
  • Experience with the ads ecosystem or ad technology.
  • Experience combatting online scams.
  • Ability to translate complex issues into simple and clear language, collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, and navigate organizational boundaries.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail in an ever-changing environment.

title: AI Software Development Intern
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Join Intel's Datacenter and AI Software Ecosystem Engineering team to help accelerate the deployment and optimization of Generative AI solutions. This internship focuses on evaluating, benchmarking, and optimizing large language model (LLM) inference workloads across Intel platforms using state-of-the-art serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, and OpenVINO. You will work on AI infrastructure, performance analysis, and cloud-native deployment solutions spanning on-premises and public cloud environments.

Project Context
Generative AI is rapidly transforming enterprise applications, with organizations increasingly deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) for conversational AI, knowledge retrieval, software development, content generation, and intelligent automation. As model sizes and user adoption continue to grow, delivering low-latency, cost-efficient, and scalable AI inference becomes a critical challenge.
Modern AI serving stacks combine model serving frameworks, optimized inference engines, cloud infrastructure, and observability platforms to deliver production-ready AI services. Organizations must balance performance metrics such as throughput, Time to First Token (TTFT), Time per Output Token (TPOT), latency, scalability, and total cost of ownership (TCO) while supporting a diverse range of deployment environments spanning on-premises datacenters, private clouds, and public cloud platforms.
This internship focuses on developing and validating modern AI inference solutions using technologies such as vLLM, SGLang, and OpenVINO. The work will involve deploying and benchmarking state-of-the-art LLMs, analyzing inference performance across Intel platforms, automating testing and deployment workflows, and evaluating cloud-native AI architectures. The objective is to help build scalable, efficient, and production-ready AI serving solutions that enable customers to maximize the value of Generative AI deployments.

What You'll Work On
You will explore the design, deployment, and optimization of Generative AI infrastructure, including:
- LLM deployment and serving: Deploy and evaluate large language models using frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, and OpenVINO
- Performance analysis: Measure and optimize serving metrics including throughput, latency, TTFT, TPOT, concurrency, and resource utilization
- AI benchmarking: Develop automated benchmarking workflows to characterize model performance across different hardware and software configurations
- Cloud infrastructure: Deploy and evaluate AI workloads in AWS and Google Cloud Platform environments
- DevOps and automation: Build CI/CD pipelines, test automation, and infrastructure tooling using Jenkins, Python, and Linux-based environments
- Data management: Design and maintain systems for storing, querying, and analyzing benchmarking and telemetry data using PostgreSQL and related technologies
- Solution validation: Investigate trade-offs between performance, scalability, accuracy, and cost across various deployment scenarios

Why This Internship?
- Cutting-edge AI engineering: Work on real-world Generative AI deployment and inference optimization challenges
- Industry impact: Contribute to technologies that help customers deploy and scale AI solutions on Intel platforms
- Hands-on experience: Gain practical expertise with LLM serving frameworks, cloud infrastructure and execution
- Mentorship: Learn from experts in AI systems, performance engineering, cloud computing, and software development
- Broad technical exposure: Develop skills across AI, Linux, DevOps, cloud computing, databases, and infrastructure automation
- Intel ecosystem: Build deep knowledge of AI deployment and optimization on Intel Xeon processors and Intel AI software solutions

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications:
- Strong background in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related field
- Programming skills: Proficiency in Python and experience developing software applications and automation tools
- LLM knowledge: Understanding of transformer-based generative AI models, inference workflows, tokenization, quantization, and serving architectures
- Linux proficiency: Experience working in Linux environments, shell scripting, system monitoring, and troubleshooting
- Academic standing: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering or related field

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with one of LLM serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, or similar
- Experience benchmarking and performance tuning AI inference workloads

title: Training Administrator
description:
AVA Law Group is seeking a Training Administrator to lead and build the firm's training and enablement function. This role will drive the development of structured onboarding, role-based training programs, policy and procedure management, and firmwide training compliance.


This is an opportunity to build a training program from the ground up. The Training Administrator will partner with department leaders and subject matter experts to transform operational knowledge into consistent, scalable learning experiences that support employee success and operational excellence across all offices. The role owns training design, delivery, scheduling, documentation, and reporting, ensuring training is standardized, adopted, and verifiable throughout the organization.


This is an on-site position in Billings, MT.


POSITION SUMMARY:

The Training Administrator is responsible for leading and managing the training and enablement function. This role develops, delivers, and maintains firmwide training programs, structured onboarding pathways, and learning resources that support employee performance, operational consistency, and policy compliance across all offices. Working closely with department leaders and subject matter experts, the Training Administrator translates business processes into effective training experiences, coordinates training delivery, maintains training records and compliance documentation, and ensures employees receive consistent, measurable, and role-specific training. Success in this role requires strong organization, instructional design, communication skills, and the ability to build scalable programs that support employee development and operational excellence.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Serve as the firm's lead trainer, designing and delivering onboarding for new hires, refresher training, and update-based training across all roles.
  • Build and administer the firm's training platform in Paylocity, including course setup, assignments, and completion tracking.
  • Design and implement a structured onboarding program, replacing the current shadow-and-go approach with deliberate, role-based training tracks.
  • Develop role-specific training tracks and materials in coordination with department leads, drawing content from internal subject-matter experts.
  • Translate firm processes and procedures into clear, role-specific training materials, quick reference guides, and checklists.
  • Coordinate and deliver recurring mandatory trainings, including facilitating sessions where process owners present their own procedures.
  • Own the firm policy library: drafting, formatting, version control, approval routing, and centralized storage.
  • Maintain training compliance records: track who was trained, on what, and when, producing documented, auditable proof of completion.
  • Monitor employee proficiency through practical demonstrations and evaluations, and sign off on training completion where required.
  • Partner with leadership to identify training gaps and build toward supervisor and management development programs as the function matures.
  • Maintain consistency of training materials and policy across all office locations.

KEY SKILLS:

  • Exceptional teaching and training skills, with the ability to engage diverse audiences and adapt delivery to different roles.
  • Strong instructional and organizational ability, with a talent for turning complex processes into clear, teachable material.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication for training delivery, policy drafting, and cross-department collaboration.
  • Comfort facilitating training sessions and holding employees and managers accountable to completion.
  • High attention to detail and strong record-keeping discipline, particularly around compliance documentation.
  • Self-motivated and able to build a function independently, from platform setup through program rollout.
  • The highest level of discretion and confidentiality when handling personnel and policy information.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in training, learning and development, instructional design, or process development.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite; experience with a learning management system or HR platform (Paylocity a plus).
  • Demonstrated ability to build training materials and deliver training to adult learners.
  • Experience leading peer training, onboarding new hires, or creating instructional documentation preferred.
  • Familiarity with legal, professional services, or administrative office environments preferred.
  • Must be able to read, comprehend, and follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Must be willing to travel between office locations for training as needed.
  • Must hold a valid driver's license.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting.
  • Perform repetitive tasks such as typing and clicking.
  • Must be able to lift and move light items up to 20 pounds at times.
  • Must be able to bend, reach, push, pull, lift, and sit.

The physical demands are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


BENEFITS:

The company offers a comprehensive benefits package including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision.
  • Voluntary life, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and short-term disability.
  • Vacation, sick and floating holidays.
  • Employee assistance program.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • 401(k) retirement plan.

title: Copy of Prior Authorization Specialist
description:
Prior Authorization Specialist

Behind every approved infusion treatment is a Prior Authorization Specialist who navigated payer policy, step therapy requirements, and paperwork so the patient never had to. We're looking for someone who thrives on solving that puzzle quickly and accurately.


Why This Role Feels Different

This isn't a repetitive data-entry job. Every case is its own investigation, requiring you to interpret clinical documentation, understand payer policy, and figure out exactly what it will take to get a patient's treatment approved.

You'll manage a real caseload of active authorizations, work across systems like Salesforce, WeInfuse, and AMD, and collaborate daily with providers, clinical teams, and internal stakeholders to keep cases moving. The work you do directly determines how quickly patients get the treatment they need.

If you like being the person who cracks the case and gets things unstuck, this role gives you that challenge every day.


The Job

The Prior Authorization Specialist is a vital team member responsible for efficiently managing the prior authorization process to ensure seamless patient care and timely treatment. This role requires a solid understanding of medical benefits, step therapy, and authorization policies, along with exceptional organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

You will manage a caseload of at least 30 active authorizations and skillfully navigate systems such as Salesforce, WeInfuse, and AMD to track and update case progress, send communications, and meet critical deadlines. This role is key to maintaining operational efficiency and directly contributes to Pure Infusion's standard of excellence and patient satisfaction.


Key Responsibilities

-Process prior authorizations accurately and efficiently, including reviewing step therapy, minimum authorization requirements, and payer-preferred medications.

-Manage appeals and denials, escalating cases when necessary, and follow appropriate payer protocols.

-Analyze insurance policies for each case and communicate with internal teams or providers to obtain needed documentation when a case does not align with policy.

-Verify insurance benefits and determine in-network (INN) or out-of-network (OON) status across various payers and states under Intake standards.

-Evaluate medical and pharmacy benefits to determine patient eligibility for treatment.

-Maintain clear, professional communication with providers, patients, internal teams, and stakeholders.

-Accurately document all case-related conversations and updates within Salesforce within required timeframes.

-Prioritize personal tasks and authorizations to ensure timely completion and follow-up.

-Collaborate with internal team members, including PACs, clinical staff, and sales, to gather or clarify case information.

-Investigate and resolve complex cases using strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

-Organize and manage authorization workload efficiently to meet performance goals.

-Follow Intake standards for accuracy and completion.


The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is highly organized, detail oriented, and energized by solving complex cases. Ideal candidates will:

-Bring proven ability to interpret clinical documentation and understand commercial and Medicare Advantage policies, including Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs).

-Communicate clearly and professionally with both clinical teams and patients.

-Manage multiple priorities confidently in a fast-paced environment.

-Bring strong documentation habits and time management skills.


Required Qualifications

-Minimum 2-3 years of experience as a Medical Assistant (MA), with direct prior authorization and biologic therapy experience.

-Strong experience working with systems like Salesforce, WeInfuse, and AMD.

-High School diploma or equivalent required.

-Certification or formal training as a Medical Assistant required.

-Biologic authorization experience required.

-Proficiency with EMRs, CRMs (Salesforce), and prior authorization systems.

-Comfortable working in software like a PMS or EMR to track information, schedule, and make notes.

-Ability to meet U.S. employment and eligibility requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

-Background in a specialty field such as Rheumatology, Gastroenterology, Dermatology, Neurology, or Immunology preferred.


Why Join Pure Infusion?

At Pure Infusion, you will find a role where your work matters in a direct and personal way. You will be part of a team that is building a better healthcare experience for patients, providers, and employees. If this resonates with you, we would love to meet you.

Thank you for considering a career with Pure Infusion. We look forward to the opportunity to work together.

AECOM is seeking an experienced Roadway Construction Inspector III to be based in Phoenix, Arizona. This position will serve as a construction inspector on roadway and transportation infrastructure projects under the general supervision of the Resident Engineer.

  • Performs or coordinates field testing of concrete, soils, and aggregates to verify compliance with project requirements.
  • Conducts sampling of construction materials, including concrete, asphalt, aggregates, and reinforcing steel.
  • Reviews construction activities and identifies potential quality issues, discrepancies, or field conditions requiring corrective action.
  • Assists with tracking construction progress, resolving field issues, and maintaining project inspection records.
  • Participates in field meetings, construction inspections, and project closeout activities as needed.
  • Provides guidance and technical support to less experienced inspection personnel when assigned.

Minimum Requirements

  • High school diploma plus 4 years of relevant construction inspection experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
  • A valid driver's license is required, along with the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check in accordance with company policy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience performing construction inspection on roadway, highway, or transportation infrastructure projects.
  • Previous experience working on Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) projects or similar state and municipal transportation projects.
  • Certifications: ACI and ATTI preferred; ATSSA Traffic Control Technician certification is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of roadway construction methods, materials, inspection procedures, and applicable specifications.

title: SoC Design Verification Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Intel is shaping the future of technology to help create a better future for the entire world. Our work in pushing forward fields like AI, analytics, and cloud-to-edge technology is at the heart of countless innovations. With a career at Intel, you'll have the opportunity to use technology to power major breakthroughs and create enhancements that improve our everyday quality of life. Join us and help make the future more wonderful for everyone. Want to learn more? Visit our YouTube Channel or the link below.


Life at Intel


In this role you will be part for the Server SoC Design Validation team, working on next-generation Xeon server product SOCs and IPs.


Who You Are:

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Performs functional logic verification and emulation validation of an integrated SoC to ensure design will meet specifications.
  • Defines and develops scalable and reusable block, subsystem, and SoC verification plans, test benches, and the verification environment to meet the required level of coverage and confirm to microarchitecture specifications.
  • Executes verification plans and defines and runs emulation and system simulation models to verify the design, analyze power and performance, and uncover bugs.
  • Replicates, root causes, and debugs issues in the pre-silicon environment.
  • Finds and implements corrective measures to resolve failing tests.
  • Collaborates and communicates with SoC architects, micro-architects, full chip architects, RTL developers, post-silicon, and physical design teams to improve verification of complex architectural and microarchitectural features.
  • Documents test plans and drives technical reviews of plans and proofs with design and architecture teams.
  • Incorporates and executes security activities within test plans, including regression and debug tests, to ensure security coverage.
  • Maintains and improves existing functional verification infrastructure and methodology.
  • Absorbs learning from post-silicon on the quality of validation done during pre-silicon development, updates test plan for missing coverages and proliferates to future products.

Behavioral traits that we are looking for:


  • Self-reliance in taking an issue to closure with internal and external partners.
  • Takes ownership of assigned tasks.
  • Keen problem solver, strong communicator, quick learner, effective team player and open to learning and teaching new and more efficient validation execution techniques to meet time-to-market.

Qualifications:

This is an entry-level position and will be compensated accordingly. You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.


Minimum Qualifications:

Master's degree in electrical or computer science, Engineering or related field.


Related coursework/technical experience in/with:

  • 10+ months experience with Silicon Design and/or Validation/Verification.
  • 10+ months experience with x86 Architecture.
  • 10+ months experience with Design and validation experience with global domains (Reset, Clock, Fuse, GPIO, MPP)

Preferred Qualifications:

Knowledge and Experience with:

  • Design and/or Design Verification with developing, maintaining, and executing complex IPs and/or SOCs.
  • Strong debug skills.
  • Robust understanding of fundamental principles of cache coherency in multi-processor SOCs, and experience with layered protocols - transaction layer, data link layer, and PHY layer.
  • UVM/SV constrained-random coverage-based design verification and Formal Verification methodology.
  • Complete verification life cycle (verification architecture, test plan, execution, debug, coverage closure).
  • Developing validation test suites and driving continuous improvement into existing validation test suites and methodologies.
  • Xeon CPU Pre-Silicon, Emulation Validation or Post Silicon Validation.
  • One or more scripting languages to facilitate automation.



Experience would be obtained through a combination of prior education level classes, and current level school classes, projects, research, and relevant previous job and/or internship experience.

title: Computer Science | Software Engineering (thesis) internship: observability-driven synthetic contract testing
description:
Introduction

The Pipeline Team within ASML’s Development Environment department supports thousands of software developers by providing reliable workflows, automation, and development tooling. The team maintains software validation, build automation, and deployment solutions used across a large internal development community. As software systems become increasingly distributed, validating integrations between services in a reliable and scalable way is a growing challenge. During this internship, you will help explore an innovative approach to contract testing by combining live-system validation with observability data. Your work will contribute to improving software reliability and testing automation at scale.

Your assignment

During this internship, you will investigate, design, and implement a platform for synthetic contract testing against live systems. Rather than relying solely on traditional test environments, the solution will continuously validate service interactions in real running environments using functional responses and observability data. You will collaborate with software development and reliability-focused teams to evaluate technical approaches, create prototypes, and deliver a scalable solution.

Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Gather requirements from software development and platform engineering stakeholders.
  • Investigate existing contract testing, monitoring, and observability solutions.
  • Evaluate and prototype alternative technical approaches.
  • Develop and implement contract validation capabilities for live services.
  • Integrate observability data, including traces and metrics, into the solution.
  • Design mechanisms for behavioral baseline creation and contract drift detection.
  • Create dashboards, documentation, and recommendations for future improvements.

This is a master's thesis internship for minimum 5 months, minimum 4 days per week (2-3 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of February 2027.


During this internship, you will gain hands-on experience with cloud-native software development, modern observability practices, distributed systems, and large-scale enterprise software platforms. You will have the opportunity to contribute to a topic that combines software engineering, system reliability, and innovation.

Your profile

To be suitable for the internship, you:

  • Are pursuing a master's degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field.
  • Have practical experience with Python and software development through academic, project, or personal work.
  • Have experience working with GitHub or similar version control platforms.
  • Have an interest in cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, and software reliability.
  • Are proactive, self-starting, and comfortable working independently while collaborating with others.
  • Have strong communication skills and are fluent in English, both spoken and written.
  • Have a curiosity for learning new technologies and exploring innovative solutions.


Other requirements you need to meet:

  • You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship, and you are at least 18 years old at the start of the internship;
  • If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement);
  • You attach your cover letter with a clear motivation on why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular;
  • You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your application shows the willingness to relocate.

This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

Inclusion and diversity

ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.

title: Manager, Implementation Services
description:
Manager, Implemetation Services
London hybrid


The Manager, DealCloud Delivery is a services leader within Intapp's DealCloud business unit, responsible for overseeing client implementations. This role combines team leadership, delivery governance, and commercial support for the Services Sales team, ensuring high-quality outcomes across a portfolio of client engagements.



What you will do:

  • Own the overall execution and delivery quality of a portfolio of client implementations, including resource staffing, resource forecasting, project budgets/profitability, and delivery team efficiency.
  • Directly manage a team of Senior Consultants, Consultants, and Associate Consultants responsible for implementation delivery to clients, providing guidance on their development and performance management, and owning their mentorship and professional growth.
  • Conduct weekly tactical check-ins with direct reports and key resources to surface project/client risks and personnel concerns within your portfolio.
  • Provide regular reporting to senior management on key accounts, financial metrics, client escalations, and personnel updates, and ensure project data is accurately maintained in the internal CRM system.
  • Build relationships with other Intapp client-facing teams (Client Success, Technical Services, Account Management, Product Support, Sales) to ensure a high-quality client experience, and with internal teams (Operations, HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance) to support hiring, reporting, and professional development.
  • Coordinate with other services team leaders (Engagement Management, Technical Services, Data) and regional Delivery Managers on large-scale or complex deliveries, and drive ongoing process improvement and methodology initiatives.
  • Serve as a senior resource providing oversight across all Intapp resources on a project, attending key meetings to provide guidance and direction, and staying closely aligned with Engagement Managers on activities, timelines, and risks.
  • Support the development of methodologies and processes in response to product evolution, team/engagement model changes, and lessons learned from completed projects, to continuously improve delivery expertise, quality, and efficiency.
  • Partner with project teams and Segment Leads/Account Managers to generate and position change orders when additional budget is required for an implementation.
  • Continuously review scoping accuracy and provide feedback to Sales/Segment Lead teams, ensure smooth knowledge transfer from Sales to Services Delivery on SOWs, and manage Services Delivery team bandwidth to support scoping activities.

What you will need:

  • 4+ years of experience in consulting/professional services, including 2+ years in a management role.
  • Prior success within a law firm, financial institution or professional services organization, with project, portfolio, or program management experience.
  • Exceptional communication skills, strong business and analytical acumen, proven success delivering complex project implementations, hands-on operational experience, and strong leadership credentials.
  • Results-oriented, highly motivated, positive, and entrepreneurial, with a can-do attitude.
  • Ability to think strategically and analytically to solve complex problems, with strong attention to detail.
  • Highly collaborative and flexible, able to adapt easily to changing or evolving role requirements.
  • Experience working with C-level client executives to deliver solutions.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with others inside and outside the organization, including with leadership.

What you will gain at Intapp:

At Intapp, you’ll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You’ll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that’s connected yet flexible and where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities. We’ll collaborate and grow together, supporting each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, innovation, and teamwork.

Here, you will have the opportunity to:

    • Expand Your Skills: Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.
    • Enjoy Where You Work: Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day.
    • Support What Matters Most: Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time off programs and our benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.

Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority. Together, we are building a company of long-term value that we can all be proud of.

title: Agile Product Owner - Cigna Healthcare
description:
About Cigna:

Cigna Healthcare is a global health service company dedicated to transforming healthcare. With roots in the U.S. and operations in over 30 countries, we serve more than 180 million customers and patients worldwide. Ranked 13th on the Fortune 500 in 2025, Cigna is recognized as one of the most trusted and influential names in the industry.

Our mission is to improve the health, well-being, and peace of mind of those we serve.

Join our globally recognized brand, where trust, communication, and a positive culture are at the core of everything we do. Our leadership is consistent, approachable, and supportive-ensuring your well-being and work-life balance.

We're looking for individuals who thrive in collaborative environments, are passionate about meaningful change, and want to grow in a company that puts people first.

At Cigna, you'll be part of a purpose-driven team that values innovation, compassion, and impact. Whether you're shaping better care experiences or supporting customers through life's key moments, your work will matter.

Grow with us-and help shape the future of healthcare.

Role Purpose:

The Product Owner is accountable for maximizing value delivery at the Scrum Team level by translating product strategy and priorities into high-quality, executable backlog items. Working in close partnership with the Agile Product Manager (APM), the Product Owner ensures customer needs, business outcomes, and delivery commitments are effectively balanced and realized through predictable, high-quality delivery. The Product Owner acts as the voice of the customer for the Scrum Team and plays a critical role in enabling continuous improvement and value realization.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with the Agile Product Manager to support product vision, roadmap, and outcomes aligned with business strategy and customer needs.
  • Ensure delivery progress and milestones are visible to keep roadmaps relevant and timely.
  • Act as the voice of the customer for the Scrum Team, ensuring backlog priorities reflect customer value.
  • Translate release train backlog priorities into clear, value-focused team backlog priorities.
  • Support Agile Product Manager in the refinement of features.
  • Lead the decomposition of features into user stories and ensure ongoing refinement with developers, testers, and business subject matter experts.
  • Own Jira backlog quality and approve user stories before moving to Done/Accepted.
  • Lead PI planning cycles and objectives to enable predictable execution at team level.
  • Collaborate with Scrum Master, QA, and UAT teams to track delivery, quality, and predictability metrics.
  • Ensure analytics are in place to monitor utilization, customer experience, and delivery performance.
  • Share actionable insights with the Agile Product Manager to drive product evolution and improvement.
  • Foster a growth mindset and a psychologically safe team culture.
  • Demonstrate an Agile mindset focused on learning, feedback, and value validation.
  • Partner with stakeholders to maintain alignment and manage dependencies.
  • Drive continuous improvement through data-informed decision making.
  • Collaborate with Customer Experience and UX/UI design teams to ensure the customer voice is embedded at all stages of the product delivery cycle. (include where applicable for external product and user feedback loop needs)

Required Competencies:

  • Strong business and delivery acumen.
  • Customer-centric mindset and empathy.
  • Ability to translate strategy into executable outcomes.
  • Ownership, accountability, and attention to quality.
  • Collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
  • Continuous improvement and data-driven mindset.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required
  • Strong English language skills required
  • Experience working in JIRA tool or an equivalent (preferred)
  • Knowledge of agile methodology [preferred/required] (depending on needs, but candidate must either have deep industry / business experience OR Agile delivery experience)
  • Experience within healthcare preferred [preferred/required] (depending on needs, but candidate must either have deep industry / business experience OR Agile delivery experience)
  • Both technically deep and business savvy enough to interface with cross-functional partners
  • Proven ability to develop strong working relationships and establish a high level of credibility across functional and lines of business
  • High attention to detail and proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
  • Demonstrates strong decision-making skills and problem-solving techniques
  • Demonstrates ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast paced and changing environment
  • Strong adaptive capability; ability to approach problems pragmatically and creatively in the phase of changing circumstances, resources and direction
  • Some degree of flexibility to work with International Health stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones
  • Agile Certification: SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager (pre or post hire)

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Combines perspectives from the product’s customers, data & analytics, operations, technology, and regulation to deliver balanced and effective solutions, in collaboration with the Product Manager.
  • Considers a range of data and technology solutions, making assessments about the value and tradeoffs of each approach across multiple dimensions including business value, delivery speed, technical considerations, and regulatory considerations.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Technical competence in data analysis, data pipelines, APIs, machine learning, and/or generative AI, and/or the regulation thereof.

About Cigna Healthcare

Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: Director, Production Infrastructure and Planning
description:
The Production Department of The Metropolitan Opera is responsible for all production and technical details related to the development and creation of opera productions and the performance of grand opera in repertory on the Met stage. The Production Department also oversees the operation and maintenance of the Metropolitan Opera stage and shop machinery, and offsite warehouse and storage operations. The Met production facilities include construction, electric, scenic, and costume shops, as well as in-house design and engineering studios.

The Director of Production Infrastructure and Planning is responsible for the planning and execution of the Production Department’s capital improvement projects, and the development of infrastructure systems and safety protocols, all in support of the performance of opera on the Met stage. This role will take the lead on long-term strategic planning for the advancement of the Met’s production capabilities and manage the department’s key vendor relationships. This is a new role requiring flexibility to develop with the needs of the department.

Primary Responsibilities

  • · Responsible for the development of a long-term capital improvement plan and the execution of production capital projects:
    • Ongoing assessment of the Met’s stage equipment and machinery
  • Prioritization of the department’s capital needs and development of a capital master plan including creation of project timelines in coordination with the technical team and organization-wide capital planning, and in light of the Met’s performance schedule
  • Plan individual capital projects including development of budget, RFPs, and resource requirements in collaboration with technical team
  • Negotiate and contract third party project management firms, consultants, and equipment vendors in coordination with Met legal department
  • Supervise the execution of production capital projects; the development and implementation of safety plans and training; permitting; budget tracking
  • · Oversee the Met’s production systems including:
    • Functionality, safety, permits and regulatory compliance of stage and workshop equipment and machinery in coordination with in-house technical team, safety director, and legal team to ensure an integrated approach to compliance and best practices.
  • Remain abreast of current and developing industry standards and guidelines regarding stage facilities
  • Coordinate with in-house and contracted resources on the planning and utilization of external production workshops and storage spaces (including 3 warehouses, 2 workshops, and a shipping container storage yard)
  • Development of annual budget and expense tracking for production systems
  • Negotiation and execution of third-party service and purchase agreements for stage equipment and systems in coordination with Met legal and finance departments
  • Maintenance of all production software licenses and administration of production software in consultation with IS (including Autodesk, Autodcad, Inventor, Vault, Trail)
  • · Production planning and operations:
    • Participate in strategic planning for future production operations and infrastructure
  • Participate in season scheduling and planning
  • Collaborate with technical and production colleagues on evaluation of new production designs re: facility and system requirements; evaluation and development of safety plans and protocols for productions

Skills and Qualifications

  • A terminal degree in Theater, Production, Management, or equivalent professional experience is required.
  • 5 years of experience in a similar position at a major theatrical venue is required.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of standard project management practices.
  • Knowledge and experience with all aspects of technical backstage operation is required.
  • A solid fundamental knowledge of Theater Production organization, practices, and techniques is essential.
  • Computer literacy is essential, including MS Office products.
  • Experience with standard technical and theatrical drafting procedures is required.
  • An ability to clearly communicate technical and artistic concepts in writing is essential.
  • Problem solving skills, including the ability to synthesize and evaluate solutions in three-dimensional space, are required.
  • Interpersonal and communication skills are crucial, as well as the ability to work on a team in a fast-paced, detail-oriented workplace.
  • Knowledge of standard opera repertory is helpful.

Physical Demands

  • Must be flexible, communicative, and collaborative
  • Must exercise balanced judgement and discretion
  • Must be able to work with a diverse group of creative people and excel at bringing teams together for complex projects
  • This is a 24/7 theater that demands a significant work commitment

Who We Are:

Thank you for your interest in Mueller Water Products, Inc.

For more than 165 years, Mueller Water Products, Inc. has been building the future of water infrastructure. From lifesaving fire protection to data intelligence, we are committed to developing products and solutions that help cities and utilities deliver clean, safe drinking water to hundreds of millions of people across North America.

Our purpose is to connect communities to water, life’s most essential resource, with exceptional, people solutions and products. Behind that purpose is a dedicated team, united by our shared values of respect, integrity, trust, inclusion and safety. With a vision to be the leader in water infrastructure solutions—solving challenges, enriching lives and safeguarding the future—we are making a positive impact that will last for generations.

By joining Mueller, you become part of a dynamic team dedicated to excellence and innovation, working collaboratively to achieve meaningful results. We champion our people because when they succeed, our communities thrive. We invite you to learn more about career opportunities with us and consider submitting your application.



Mechanical Engineering - Development Program

At Mueller Water Products, we want to change the way people access clean, safe drinking water by manufacturing products and providing solutions that bring real value to the world, whether it’s at the source, at the plant, below the ground on the street, or in a cloud.


Over the past 160 years, we've seen this mission spread beyond our wildest dreams. Today, we are a leading manufacturer and marketer of products and services used in the transmission, distribution and measurement of water in North America. So how did we reach this far? We are constantly learning through our commitments to new product development and manufacturing excellence, and we are taking those lessons in innovative ways and creative solutions that will better serve our customer, support our communities, and protect our planet.


Mueller Development Program (MDP) Overview

The Mueller Development Program (MDP) is designed to support early-career professionals through structured development opportunities, dedicated mentorship, and organized events. Over a two-year period, participants rotate through different roles and may relocate to various Mueller locations—gaining broad exposure that strengthens leadership capabilities, deepens technical expertise, and builds professional confidence.

Rotations, lasting between 6 to 12 months, are determined based on functional area, business needs, and individual career aspirations. This structure allows participants to gain hands-on experience across multiple disciplines within the field across our various sites, including:
Albertville, AL · Atlanta, GA · Brownsville, TX · Chattanooga, TN · Cleveland, TN · Cleveland, NC · Decatur, IL · Kimball, TN

Function / Position Summary

The Multi Abilities Classroom (MAC) paraeducator supports the classroom by assisting in the implementation of structured instructional, behavioral, social and communication supports aligned to the MAC curriculum and practices. Provide direct support to students with significant academic learning, communication and behavioral needs, including assistance with personal care, feeding and toileting as required. Perform duties under the direct supervision of a certified staff member, contribute to a consistent, hands on and supportive learning environment while maintaining confidentiality of student, staff and department information.

Job Duties / Responsibilities

  • Implement individual or small group instructional activities under the direction of the MAC teacher, using established routines, visual supports and structured practices.
  • Familiarize yourself with student IEP goals, objectives, accommodations and behavior supports to assist with consistent implementation across the school day.
  • Support the use of communication systems, visual schedules, reinforcement systems and other structured supports that align with MAC expectations and individual student needs.
  • Follow through on defined behavioral intervention plans and procedures, including implementation of proactive strategies, reinforcement systems and de-escalation supports as directed by the teacher.
  • Assist with data collection, including academic, behavioral, social and communication data, and document information as requested by the teacher.
  • Support a structured classroom environment by preparing, organizing and maintaining materials and assisting with environmental setup as directed by the teacher.
  • Supervise students during lunch, recess, arrival, departure and community-based activities.
  • Escort students within the building, including transitions to specials/electives, therapies and other instructional spaces.
  • Assist with the loading and unloading of student buses during assigned work hours.
  • Work cooperatively with the teacher by assisting with any activity aligned to student IEP needs, including instructional tasks, communication supports, social skills and behavior routines.
  • Provide personal care support to students, including lifting, transferring, positioning, feeding, toileting and hygiene needs, consistent with special skills expectations.
  • Support students in building independence, communication, self-regulation and engagement throughout the school day.
  • Provide input to the teacher regarding student responses, communication attempts, behavior patterns and other needs.
  • Attend staff meetings and professional development activities as assigned
  • Maintain confidentiality of student, staff and department information within the school and community.
  • Be willing to complete and maintain certification in CPI and Ukeru to support safe, proactive approaches to behavior support.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education

  • Para Educator, Substitute, Professional Educator or Provisional Educator License required.
  • Minimum education requirement for a Para Educator license is completion of at least 60 semester hours of college course work or a passing score on the ETS Para Pro exam or two specific Work Keys exams.
  • Bilingual – Spanish/English (written/verbal) preferred.
  • Assignments in multi-lingual or bilingual classrooms require Bilingual-Spanish/English

Experience / Knowledge

  • 3 years of Para Educator experience or classroom assistant for students with disabilities preferred
  • Experience with students who have behavioral needs preferred
  • Experience as a Behavior technician or Registered Behavior Technician strongly preferred
  • Ability to collaborate with staff and students in a way that is collaborative, student friendly and productive
  • Familiarity with data collection preferred

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work through many interruptions throughout the school day
  • Required prolonged standing, bending, start/stop and sitting
  • Lifting may be required to manually move, carry, pull or push heavy objects or materials
  • Assisting with toileting needs may be required as needed
  • Ability to perform CPI approved restraint once trained
  • Excellent physical agility and quick response time

Terms of Employment

  • This is a 9-month position.
  • Salary and benefits are established by the Board of Education and set forth in the collective bargaining agreement as applicable.
  • The starting rate for this role is $23.38/hr.

title: Production Planner
description:
About ASML and the Wilton Site


ASML develops advanced technology that helps semiconductor manufacturers produce the microchips that power many of the products people use every day. Across more than 60 locations globally, our teams work together to advance semiconductor technology and develop solutions for some of the industry’s most complex challenges.


Our Wilton, Connecticut location is ASML’s largest research, development, and manufacturing site in the United States. The site specializes in advanced mechatronics, alignment and sensor technology, and optical fabrication. Teams in Wilton design and manufacture high-value modules and sensors that are critical to the performance of ASML’s lithography and metrology systems



Introduction to the Job


As a Production Planner, you will transform long-term manufacturing goals into practical, executable production plans. Your work will help ASML’s Wilton factory produce the advanced technology used within the semiconductor industry.


You will coordinate materials, capacity, equipment, tooling, and resources across a 13-week planning horizon. By identifying risks early and developing solutions, you will help manufacturing teams meet production and delivery commitments.


Role and Responsibilities


The Production Planner monitors production performance and adjusts plans as factory conditions change. You will partner with manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, warehousing, engineering, and material handling teams.


  • Develop and maintain feasible production plans across a 13-week planning horizon.
  • Monitor production progress, work in progress, inventory, and capacity against the established plan.
  • Identify material shortages and coordinate actions that protect upcoming production requirements.
  • Evaluate equipment, tooling, facility, and resource constraints while developing practical planning scenarios.
  • Analyze production risks, bottlenecks, and performance trends using enterprise planning systems and Microsoft Excel.
  • Support new-product introductions and engineering changes by reviewing timing, production impact, and implementation risks.
  • Lead cross-functional improvements that strengthen planning processes, cycle time, delivery performance, and resource utilization.

Education and Experience


To succeed as a Production Planner, you will need:

  • 3+years production planning or supply chain experience within manufacturing.
  • One or more years of experience using SAP or a comparable enterprise resource planning system.
  • 2+ years of experience managing relationships with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, conditional formatting, pivot tables, and charts.
  • Experience supporting at least one new-product introduction within a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Lean methodology or another structured continuous improvement approach.
  • A bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, mechanical engineering, supply chain management, communications, or a related discipline is preferred.
  • Relevant APICS certification in planning, supply chain, project management, engineering, or master data is preferred.

Skills

Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.


To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills:


  • Analyze complex production information and translate findings into clear recommendations.
  • Communicate risks, priorities, and proposed actions to technical and operational stakeholders.
  • Manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and meeting planning deadlines.
  • Collaborate across teams to resolve material, capacity, and production constraints.
  • Demonstrate ownership by addressing problems proactively and following actions through completion.
  • Adapt production plans when priorities, resources, or manufacturing conditions change.
  • Present data and recommendations clearly using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Work independently while contributing to shared factory and team objectives.

The Production Planner will also serve as a subject-matter resource for an assigned planning process. You will support colleagues, share knowledge, and help implement sustainable process improvements.


This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

title: Senior Project Architect (Adaptive Re-use + Preservation) at DELV Design
description:
Our client, DELV Design, is growing its team again!

About DELV

DELV’s place-based practice unites creative, human-centered design with a pragmatic and collaborative spirit, crafting authentic contemporary spaces anchored in community and context. Our approach is built on a shared purpose: enriching our communities through thoughtful design. Our process is deliberately divergent and iterative, balancing opportunities and constraints with optimism. We are research-based and relationship-driven. We respect cultural, environmental, and economic forces in the pursuit of quality and meaningful solutions that endure. We foster connections through thoughtful engagement to guide our clients through transformational work.

About the Role

As a senior project architect focusing on adaptive re-use and preservation, you will lead projects and design teams to most effectively renovate, rehabilitate, and preserve older and/or historic buildings for new uses. You’ll also help the firm pursue additional clients and expand this area of design expertise. Working alongside a collaborative design team, you will lead projects through all phases of due diligence/assessments, design, approvals and permitting, construction administration, and closeout. Mentoring younger staff assigned to these project types will be critical to the success of the firm’s projects in these areas and to the growth of our team members as architects and designers

title: Ground Ramp Agent
description:
Job Description:

Do you enjoy working outdoors in a fast-paced, safety-obsessed aviation environment?

As a Ramp Agent, you will be essential in ensuring that flights run on time by providing efficient ground support services.

Alliance Ground International (AGI) is one of the largest independently owned ground handling companies providing services to 100+ airlines in 61 airports across the U.S. and Canada. We are the home to over 12,000 team members supporting over 1.5B Kilos and over 400K departures. Our Ground division has a strong reputation in aviation ground services. We are committed to providing the highest quality service and continuing our outstanding safety track record. As we continue to grow, we only look for the best in the industry.

Job responsibilities:

  • Guide inbound/outbound airplanes to and from the gate.

  • Transport, lift, load/unload, sort and transfer passenger baggage, cargo, and mail material in and out of aircraft bins, belt loader, or baggage carts in a safe manner.

  • Safeguards customer baggage, air cargo, airmail from weather, loss, theft, damage and/or destruction.

  • Clean aircraft passenger cabins between flights and stock aircraft with needed supplies.

  • Operate heavy equipment such as pushback equipment and maintain visual contact with Wing Walkers to ensure the equipment is free of any danger.

  • Operate and/or drive motorized equipment, such as belt loaders, air start units, lift trucks, push back tugs, bag cart, lavatory cart, and deicers; or manually push and pull push carts and containers. Operate equipment to move luggage and cargo, tow planes between gates, and refill water tanks and lavatories.

  • Receive and record customer baggage, air freight, mail, and company materials as required.

  • Pick up, deliver, and transport cargo and baggage to and from aircraft, which could include wheelchairs, strollers, live animals, and other vital property of passengers, and prepare records in connection with these responsibilities.

  • Complete paperwork and forms connected with work assignments pertaining to procedures and enter data into company's information system as required.

  • Follow company procedures and protocols to ensure we are always operating in a safe and responsible manner.

  • Complete all training when required by company, airport governing authority, or customer when required.

  • Be on time, be prepared, and be safe. Be willing to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

Safety, Security and Compliance:

All AGI Team members have a responsibility and duty while at work to:

  • Take reasonable care for the health, wellbeing, safety, and security of themselves and of others who may be affected by their actions or omissions while at work.

  • Cooperate with their manager / supervisor to allow them to perform or comply with any legal requirements imposed on the company.

  • Not intentionally or recklessly interfere with or misuse anything provided by the company in the interests of health, wellbeing, safety, security or welfare reasons.

  • Inform their manager / supervisor of any work situation, equipment, or activity that represents a serious or immediate danger to health, wellbeing, safety, and security.

  • Report any hazards, near misses, incidents, accidents, or dangerous occurrences to their manager / supervisor, who will then follow the procedures contained in company and carrier Safety and Security procedures.

  • Carry out work in accordance with information and training provided and any specific health, wellbeing, safety, and security rules or procedures.

  • Fully understand AGI Health & Safety and Security policies.

  • Attend training courses as may be required by AGI.

Physical Requirements:

  • This job requires physical stamina and strength – Ramp Agents must be able to lift / carry / push / pull and move items 70 pounds (32 kg) or more on a regular basis and repetitively lift items weighing 40 to 50 pounds on raised surfaces.

  • Must be able to carry heavy items up and down narrow jetway stairs.

  • Must be able to walk, climb, bend, kneel, crawl, and stoop on a frequent basis and for extended periods.

  • Must be able to work in cramped or high places.

  • Must be able to be alerted to moving vehicles or aircraft and use radio equipment to communicate with crew and airport authorities.

  • Must be able to work outside in all types of weather, around jet and machinery noises.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Good Communication Skills – Ramp Agents must be able to communicate information and instructions verbally and/or via radio equipment effectively in a professional manner with the flight crew, gate agents, and other ground crew to coordinate the movement and handling of planes, equipment, baggage, and cargo.

  • Basic math skills: Ramp agents may be required to calculate weight and balance calculations for planes.

  • Computer skills: Ramp agents may be required to use computer systems to track cargo and baggage.

  • Problem-solving skills: Ramp agents may be called upon to troubleshoot issues during loading and unloading.

  • Time management skills: Ramp agents must be able to manage their time effectively to complete tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment.


Qualifications:

  • Be at least 18 years of age and possess a high school diploma, GED, or work experience equivalent.

  • Possess a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.

  • If work location is in the United States, must have authorization to work in the United States as defined by the Immigration Reform Act of 1986. If work location is in Canada, must have authorization to work in Canada as defined by the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act (IRPA) of 2001.

  • Must complete ramp and SIDA training to obtain airport authority identification security.

  • If required by customer or role access, be able to secure a Customs Seal through the respective governing agency.

  • Preferred Qualifications - One+ year of relevant experience.

AGI offers a comprehensive benefit package for all employees, including paid vacation and medical / dental / vision for full-time qualified employees as well as medical coverage for part time employees. AGI also provides free uniforms and free on-the-job training to all employees. Additional benefits include company-matched 401(k) program, company-paid employee assistance program, voluntary life insurance, and travel discounts on car rentals, hotels, and cruises to name a few.

The successful AGI team member brings their “A” game every day with energy and enthusiasm, respect for their team, and the highest regard for safety!

AGI is committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or veteran status.

title: Product Design Associate (Mandarin Preferred)
description:
Position Overview

This position is responsible for design execution, production coordination, and quality control for physical products within the product design system. The goal is to support efficient expansion of the company’s physical product lines and ensure consistent, stable, high-quality execution. Working with the Product Design Manager, the Product Designer helps define packaging structures, visual architecture, and grid systems, then accurately translates approved concepts into packaging design files that meet product positioning, compliance requirements, and production conditions. The role also coordinates with external manufacturers and contract factories to clarify product specifications, design requirements, and production processes; tracks and reviews samples; and promptly reports deviations, conflicts, and risks during production.

The Product Designer primarily executes and translates packaging visual concepts into production-ready deliverables. Internally, the role works with the Product Design Manager to define packaging formats, information hierarchy, and visual effects, and works with the Product Information & Compliance Specialist to accurately place required legal information, product instructions, and other necessary content. Externally, the role provides manufacturers with clear, accurate, actionable requirements, design drawings, and process specifications; objectively evaluates samples against approved standards; and coordinates or escalates issues as needed.

At the team level, the role also assists the Product Design Manager in coordinating basic execution tasks assigned to Product Design Assistants, clarifying task requirements and delivery standards, and overseeing file organization, design adaptation, and document archiving to keep physical product development and design execution efficient, standardized, and orderly.


Job Responsibilities

1.Core Visual Adaptation and SKU Execution

a. Use established internal layout systems proficiently to independently and efficiently lay out and adapt high volumes of derivative SKUs each month.
b. Translate approved core design concepts accurately into standardized foundational 3D physical-structure models and 2D outer-packaging visual files, ensuring aesthetic consistency and standardization across large-volume output.


2.Cross-functional Coordination and Compliance Content Layout

a. For packaging intended for the product’s target sales markets, take the verified copy supplied by the Product Information & Compliance Specialist and reorganize and lay it out in a clear, attractive manner without compromising the product’s overall design or brand identity.


3.Production Handover and Objective Sample Verification

a. Provide external factories with complete and accurate design files, product requirements, and specifications needed for mass production.
b. Track factory progress on first samples and production samples. Use standardized lighting to objectively compare color accuracy and verify the structural suitability and dimensional precision of physical white-box samples.


4.Execution Workflow Coordination

a. Responsible for appropriately breaking down and assigning routine, basic tasks to Product Design Specialists.

b. Responsible for conducting preliminary compliance and quality checks on basic work submitted by assistants, catching common errors, and ensuring that all deliverables meet professional standards.


Qualifications

  • Education: A bachelor’s degree or higher in visual communication, graphic design, packaging design, or a related field from an art or design institution is preferred.
  • Professional Experience: At least 2 years of experience in physical product or packaging development, with proven experience delivering mature projects to mass production. Familiarity with contract manufacturing processes and cross-time-zone collaboration is required.
  • Knowledge & Skills: Proficiency in English and Chinese, with the ability to communicate in writing and verbally across international teams. Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite and knowledge of Pantone color standards and color accuracy.
  • Core Competencies: Strong ability to work under pressure and exceptional attention to detail. Clear technical reasoning and the ability to turn production conflicts into structured analysis reports for efficient escalation and resolution.

Compensation

  • $22-$25 per hour
  • Quarterly Performance Bonus: This position is eligible for a quarterly performance-based bonus, subject to the eligibility requirements, performance criteria, and terms of the Company's bonus program.


Benefits

  • 401(k) & 401(k) matching - subject to the eligibility requirements
  • Paid Sick Leave
  • Employee discount
  • Health insurance
  • Paid Time Off


Language Requirement: Proficiency in English and Mandarin is preferred
