RSM is seeking a visionary Managing Director of Brand Strategy to define, evolve, and steward our enterprise brand strategy and platform in support of the firm’s business and growth ambitions.


Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer and serving on the Marketing and Communications Leadership Team, this leader will translate RSM’s objectives, markets, clients, and offerings into a distinctive brand point of view. You will shape how RSM is understood and experienced across audiences, channels, and business units.


Operating at both the enterprise and regional levels, this role will partner across RSM’s executive offices and work closely with regional counterparts to align enterprise brand direction with local market and business needs. The ideal leader understands how to operate within a matrixed or federated organization, establishing consistent enterprise-wide standards while enabling regions to adapt and execute in ways that are relevant to their markets.


This role leads enterprise brand positioning and narrative, talent brand, partnerships and activations, advertising and media strategy, and brand-side agency relationships. You will collaborate with leaders across Marketing, Communications, Content, Growth, Analytics, HR, Sales, and the business to bring the brand to life in relevant, compelling, and measurable ways globally.


What you’ll do

  • Lead enterprise brand strategy. Create, evolve, and steward RSM’s strategy and platform, including positioning, value proposition, brand promise, narrative architecture, messaging principles, audience considerations, and strategic expression.
  • Integrate brand across marketing and communications. Ensure the brand platform guides campaigns, demand generation, events, experiences, communications, and other priority initiatives across markets. Bring strong brand judgment to briefs and strategic decisions without becoming an approval bottleneck.
  • Drive brand activation and partnerships. Lead the brand perspective on partnerships, sponsorships, and activation opportunities, helping determine where and how RSM should show up regionally to build awareness, relevance, and preference with priority audiences.
  • Advance the talent brand. Oversee talent brand strategy in close partnership with HR and Talent Acquisition, supporting a consistent and compelling employer brand across regions.
  • Guide agency, advertising, and creative partnerships. Lead brand-side agency relationships and provide informed direction on advertising, media, and brand activation. Partner with internal and external creative leaders to translate brand strategy into distinctive creative expression without assuming the creative director role.
  • Measure and optimize brand performance. Partner with Analytics, Growth, and Marketing leaders to define meaningful brand measures. Use research, market response, campaign performance, and qualitative insights to strengthen future activations and investment recommendations.
  • Lead through influence and collaboration. Build the brand capabilities needed for an evolving organization, establish standards, develop talent, manage agency partners, and influence senior stakeholders across RSM’s federated model.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree with relevant professional experience required; master’s degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in brand strategy, integrated marketing, brand leadership, or a related field, including significant leadership responsibility within a complex, matrixed, federated, or multinational organization.
  • Demonstrated success creating or materially evolving an enterprise brand platform and applying it across multiple audiences, channels, business units, markets, or regions.
  • Experience working in an organization with enterprise-wide standards and shared strategic direction, along with regional or local flexibility in how those standards are activated and executed.
  • Proven ability to align enterprise brand strategy with regional business priorities, market dynamics, and audience needs while maintaining a cohesive brand.
  • Strong marketing and commercial fluency, with the ability to understand what an organization sells, how it grows, whom it serves, and how brand can support those objectives.
  • Experience leading or significantly influencing brand activation, partnerships and sponsorships, advertising, media, and agency relationships.
  • Experience with talent brand or recruitment marketing strategy, or close partnership with HR and Talent Acquisition.
  • A combination of in-house and agency or consultancy experience is strongly preferred. Significant experience managing senior agency and creative partners may also qualify.
  • Proven ability to influence and collaborate across functions, business units, regions, and geographies without relying on direct authority.
  • Experience partnering with executive leadership and regional counterparts is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in complex B2B, technology, consulting, professional services, or another matrixed enterprise environment is valuable, but not required for candidates who demonstrate strong business learning and enterprise application.

How you lead

  • Balance consistency with regional relevance and business needs.
  • Influence and collaborate effectively across enterprise and regional leadership teams.

title: Assistant Manager of Experiences- Robert Mondavi Winery
description:
Job Description


Position Summary

  • The Assistant Manager, Experiences at Robert Mondavi Winery supports the day-to-day operations of hospitality and guest experiences. Working closely with the Hospitality leadership team, this role helps deliver exceptional guest programming and ensures that every visitor interaction reflects the iconic Robert Mondavi brand and the values of Constellation Brands. The Assistant Manager, Experiences collaborates with cross-functional teams, coordinates guest experience logistics and helps maintain the winery’s reputation as a premier Napa Valley destination.

Key Responsibilities

Guest Experience & Programming

  • The Assistant Manager, Experiences is instrumental in crafting and delivering engaging daily guest experiences and educational programs that bring RMW to life, fostering meaningful and lasting connections with our visitors. This role oversees the execution of all hospitality activities including public tastings and tailored guest interactions ensuring every service touchpoint is seamless, consistent, and memorable. In addition, the Assistant Manager develops and implements guest experience strategies that directly support revenue growth and key performance indicators (KPIs), such as guest engagement, sales per visitor, and customer retention. By closely monitoring guest feedback and analyzing performance data, this position continually elevates daily experiences, maximizes guest satisfaction, and drives measurable business outcomes.

Operational Support & Excellence

  • The Assistant Manager, Experiences is responsible for ensuring that all hospitality environments consistently meet the highest standards of cleanliness, safety, and presentation, creating an inviting and polished atmosphere for every guest. A key aspect of this role is supporting the implementation and strict adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs), which are essential for maintaining operational efficiency, accuracy, and regulatory compliance across all guest-facing activities. The Assistant Manager also assists in managing staffing schedules, resource allocation, and day-to-day logistics to optimize service delivery and ensure the smooth functioning of the hospitality team. Additionally, this role participates in regular reviews of operational performance, actively contributing ideas for process improvement and innovation, and helping to refine SOPs to further elevate both guest satisfaction and operational excellence.

Financial & Business Support

  • The Assistant Manager, Experiences plays a pivotal role in supporting the financial and business operations of the hospitality function. This role assists in tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) related to guest engagement, foot traffic, and revenue generated from daily guest experiences. The Assistant Manager contributes valuable insights for monthly business reports and identifies operational gaps or opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • In addition to overseeing daily operations with a focus on cost control, this position is instrumental in achieving financial and attendance targets, directly contributing to the ongoing success and profitability of the hospitality team. Responsibilities also include managing stocktaking processes to ensure accurate inventory control, as well as providing support and oversight for operational systems such as Tock, TripleSeat, and Shopify. By effectively managing these critical areas, the Assistant Manager helps drive overall business performance and an exceptional guest experience.

Destination Marketing & Collaboration

  • The Assistant Manager, Experiences supports destination marketing efforts by overseeing the reservation process and actively managing guest feedback. This role collaborates with internal teams and external partners to promote Robert Mondavi Winery as a top Napa Valley destination, ensuring that reservations and guest communications reflect the winery’s high standards of service. The Assistant Manager is responsible for monitoring guest feedback throughout the reservation and visit experience, using these insights to evaluate the effectiveness of marketing initiatives and guest programming. By identifying opportunities for improvement and participating in outreach campaigns with local tourism boards, hospitality organizations, and neighboring wineries, this position helps drive increased foot traffic and ensures that every visitor’s experience aligns with the brand’s promise.

Cross-Functional Teamwork

  • The Assistant Manager, Experiences works closely with key departments across the CBI organization most notably Brand, Direct to Consumer, Public Relations, and Human Resources to ensure unified messaging and a coordinated approach to guest experiences throughout the winery’s hospitality operations. This role is pivotal in supporting the implementation of consistent global brand standards across all hospitality activities, collaborating with international teams when necessary to uphold brand integrity and deliver seamless, high-quality experiences for guests. By cultivating strong cross-functional relationships, the Assistant Manager ensures that hospitality initiatives are aligned with broader business objectives and that every guest interaction consistently reflects the Robert Mondavi Winery brand.

Facility & Experience Coordination

  • The Assistant Manager, Experiences is responsible for overseeing daily facility maintenance to ensure that all guest spaces and equipment are meticulously maintained and presented at a premium standard. This role supports the flawless execution of consumer visits by coordinating logistics and maintaining a welcoming, polished atmosphere for every guest. Through diligent attention to facility upkeep and guest readiness, the Assistant Manager helps create an exceptional and memorable environment that consistently reflects the high standards of Robert Mondavi Winery.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Proven experience in hospitality, event coordination, or guest services; wine industry experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with a collaborative and proactive approach to working with both internal and external teams.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen, including knowledge of budgeting, cost control, and the ability to interpret key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Flexibility to work varied hours, including weekends and evenings, to support guest programming and business needs.
  • Strong attention to detail, a passion for delivering outstanding guest experiences, and a commitment to upholding the brand standards of Robert Mondavi Winery.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, business, marketing, or a related field.
  • Minimum of three years of experience in the hospitality industry, with at least one year in a supervisory or assistant management role; wine industry or luxury hospitality experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to support brand positioning and marketing strategies within a guest-focused environment.
  • Experience developing, tracking, and interpreting program KPIs related to guest engagement and revenue.
  • Strong background in collecting and leveraging guest feedback to inform improvements in guest experience.
  • Proficiency in supporting guest programming or new service rollouts.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and deliver outstanding guest service.
  • Experience training or mentoring team members and supporting a positive team culture.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to handle multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); experience with reservation or customer management systems is a plus.
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and able to work independently, demonstrating initiative and sound judgment.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement and upholding high standards of guest experience and brand integrity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • WSET 2 or better required
  • Luxury and/or hospitality experience preferred but not required

Physical Requirements/Other

  • Able to lift 40lbs on occasion.
  • Work in a normal office environment. Sit at a workstation for up to 2-hour intervals. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Must be flexible in work style, location, and schedule: travel up to 30%, the wine industry is a hospitality-oriented industry, so availability to work weekends and evenings on occasion as required.
  • Must have valid U.S. Passport.

Location

Oakville, California

Full time

Hospitality & Retail

title: Radiology Tech II
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Department:

Diagnostic Imaging

Under minimal supervision, performs specialized diagnostic and therapeutic procedures as requested by a physician to assist in the diagnosis and treatment of patients. Demonstrates the knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of the patients served on his/her unit. Performs other duties as assigned. Performs any combination of the following duties depending on the area of assignment.


Primary Job Duties:

  • Performs at least two separate modalities in Diagnostic Imaging such as: X-ray and either Angiography or Computed Tomography of the following areas: neuro, abdominal, chest and extremities. Assists physicians in performing other fluoroscopic procedures as needed.
  • Transports patients by stretcher, bed, wheelchair, or walking. Provides care for patients during transportation and within the department, if necessary.
  • Assists patients by lifting and moving them off and on the x-ray table. Provides bedpans and urinals as needed. Assures that patients are properly dressed for procedures.
  • Prepares patient for their exam by consenting, explaining exam and answering patient questions.
  • Starts intravenous lines and administers contrast and other preparations as to complete exam in a timely fashion.
  • Cares for patient during procedures by assisting them to rest rooms, providing blankets, etc.
  • Monitors patient condition pre and post-procedure and reports changes in the patient's condition to Radiologist or RN for follow-up.
  • Assists with emergency medical treatment under physician direction.
  • Pulls contrast from medication dispenser per protocol and documents contrast in hospital information system (HIS) per protocol.
  • Loads the power injector for contrast studies.
  • Technologist may give contrast medias and may flush lines with normal saline contrast/normal saline.
  • Under direct supervision of the Radiologist, the technologist may pull Xylocaine for procedure.
  • Under direct supervision of the Radiologist, the technologist may use heparinized saline to flush catheters.
  • Performs data entry in computer systems necessary for work flow and patient care, such as: Radiology information system (RIS) and hospital information system (HIS).
  • Performs related duties such as reporting equipment malfunctions, assisting others, and special assignments. Cleans work area and replenishes supplies.
  • Attends regularly scheduled department meetings and in-services to maintain working knowledge of changes in machines, and protocols. Maintains CEU’s and CPR for license.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements:



Education: Completion of a two-year Radiologic Technology training program approved by the American Medical Association (AMA) required.


Licensure: CRT (California Radiologic Technologist) and Fluoroscopy license, ARRT (American College of Radiologic Technologist) certificates (R )- Radiology and for CT Techs (CT ) Computed Tomography are required. Current BLS/Healthcare Provider status as per American Heart Association standards required. Valid Driver’s License required.


Experience: One year of experience as a licensed Radiologic technologist required. One year of experience in either CT or Angiography/Special Procedures preferred.


Essential Technical/Motor Skills: Knowledge of radiographic equipment and radiation safety (patient and operator). The ability to assist with patient injections and changing dressings requires the use of fine motor skills and precise hand/eye coordination.


Interpersonal Skills: Excellent interpersonal skills in dealing with patients, public and co-workers. Work requires ability to communicate effectively about complex matters with others who have varying levels of comprehension and knowledge (written and oral).


The hourly rate for this position is $57.44 - $69.12. The range displayed on this job posting reflects the target for new hire salaries for this position.

title: Vice President, Content Strategy & Distribution
description:
The Vice President, Content Strategy & Distribution, owns content strategy, creative direction, and content operations across a portfolio of collegiate athletic properties, with a particular focus on leading and growing Learfield’s content capabilities across the Big Ten.
This is a senior leadership role responsible for setting the vision and strategy for how content is created, distributed, and monetized across the portfolio. The VP will lead a team of content professionals embedded within collegiate athletic departments and serve as a trusted strategic partner to school leadership, revenue teams, brand partners, and internal stakeholders.
The role sits at the intersection of content, college sports, media, and business, with responsibility for creating content that both strengthens the connection between schools and their audiences and creates meaningful commercial opportunities.
The ideal candidate is a proven content leader who understands how to build great stories, develop high-performing teams, and translate audience engagement into business results. They should be equally comfortable developing a long-term content strategy with an athletic department leader, reviewing performance data with a team, collaborating with a national brand, and helping a creator improve a piece of content. This role will be based in Dallas, Texas or New York City.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Lead the overall content vision and strategy across a portfolio of collegiate athletic properties, with a particular focus on Big Ten schools.
  • Partner with NIL, athlete marketing, and school teams to develop student-athlete content strategies, helping schools and brands responsibly incorporate athletes and creators into programming and commercial opportunities.
  • Lead, develop, and mentor a distributed team of content leaders, producers, creators, and social specialists embedded within partner athletic departments.
  • Build strong relationships with athletic department leadership, school social teams, creators, coaches, athletes, and other key stakeholders to serve as the senior content partner.
  • Develop clear content strategies for each property based on its brand, audience, priorities, and commercial objectives.
  • Build and execute strategies designed to grow audience engagement, content inventory, social performance, and revenue.
  • Partner closely with sales and revenue teams to develop high-value branded content opportunities that align the objectives of schools, athletes, and brand partners.
  • Identify new content products, formats, franchises, and revenue opportunities that can scale across multiple properties.
  • Establish content KPIs and measurement frameworks and use audience and performance data to continually improve content strategy and investment.
  • Evaluate performance across schools, platforms, campaigns, and content franchises and translate insights into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Establish best practices for short-form video, social content, branded content, original programming, and emerging content formats.
  • Ensure content reflects the unique voice, culture, and identity of each school while maintaining a high standard of quality across the portfolio.
  • Create scalable processes and tools with colleagues that allow successful strategies, formats, insights, and programs to be replicated across the portfolio that can be tailored to school’s individual voice/tone.
  • Work closely with branded content, production, sales, distribution, marketing, and other internal teams to create integrated content strategies and maximize opportunities across the business.
  • Help schools increase the value of their owned and social platforms through stronger programming, organic distribution, audience development, and content optimization.
  • Stay ahead of trends across college sports, social media, digital video, streaming, and the broader media landscape and identify opportunities to bring new ideas and capabilities to partner schools.
  • Provide strategic direction, coaching, and mentorship to property content teams and serve as a senior resource for content strategy, creative development, and execution.
  • Establish and maintain standards for storytelling, voice, tone, quality, and brand alignment.
  • Lead competitive and industry research to identify emerging opportunities, platforms, formats, and best practices.
  • Help shape and evolve Learfield’s broader content and owned media strategy, including opportunities to build scalable content platforms and products that extend beyond individual school properties.
  • Support senior leadership with strategic planning, business reviews, board presentations, and other company-wide initiatives.
  • Partner with senior leadership on budget and resource allocation to support team needs and growth opportunities
  • Serve as a connector across the organization, bringing together the right people and resources to solve on-going challenges and unlock opportunities.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships across stakeholders, with the judgment and communication skills to navigate complex issues or competing priorities

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of experience in content, media, sports, entertainment, branded content, or a related field.
  • Significant experience leading content teams and developing content strategies for major brands, media platforms, sports properties, or entertainment organizations.
  • Strong leadership, mentorship, and team-building skills, with a track record of developing high-performing, distributed teams across multiple properties, markets, or organizations.
  • Experience with analytics platform such as Zoomph, project management systems such as AirTable, and experience working in Meta Business suite, TikTok Analytics, and YouTube Studio preferred.
  • Deep understanding of college athletics, the college sports media landscape, with understanding of the culture, audiences and business dynamics with meaningful experience working with or around Power Four programs and particularly Big Ten institutions.
  • Strong understanding of social platforms, digital video, streaming, and emerging media formats.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop content strategies that drive both audience growth and commercial results.
  • Experience developing branded content and working closely with sales teams, advertisers, and commercial partners.
  • Experience working directly with senior executives, clients, athletic department leadership, and other high-level stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of how content, audience, and commercial strategy intersect.
  • Demonstrated ability to use audience and performance data to inform content strategy, investment, and optimization.
  • Exceptional communication, writing, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to operate at both the strategic and executional level, moving comfortably between setting the broader vision and helping teams solve day-to-day challenges.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships and operate effectively in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.
  • Willingness and ability to travel overnight regularly to partner schools, industry events, and key meetings.
  • Other related duties as assigned

Pay Transparency:


The approximate national base pay range for this position is $165,000 to $200,000. Please note that this is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Individuals may also be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus and/or sales compensation based on individual and company performance. Placement on the range may vary based on factors including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, and geographic location. The pay rate will comply with all minimum federal, state, and local wage/salary requirements.

Learfield offers a full spectrum of benefits for eligible employees including Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Life Insurance and Other Insurance Plans, Flexible Paid Time Off (minimum 10+ days annually), including Parental Leave, 20 Paid Holidays, 401(k) + Match, and Short/Long Term Disability. Leave benefits are consistent with state and local laws, including the Colorado Health Families and Workplaces Act.

Learfield is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race; color; sex; gender identity; sexual orientation; religious practices and observances; national origin; pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions; status as a protected veteran or spouse/family member of a protected veteran; or disability.

title: Team Coordinator/Client Service Sr. Associate
description:
Role Description:

The Team Coordinator/Client Service Sr. Associate provides client service, operational, and administrative support to the advisory team and clients, helping ensure a consistent, high-quality client experience and effective day-to-day team operations. This role supports more complex client service and administrative responsibilities while coordinating activities across internal teams to meet client and advisor needs.


Working closely with Advisors, Wealth Planning Associates, and other internal teams, the Team Coordinator/Client Service Sr. Associate contributes to the ongoing improvement of client service and operational processes and supports the successful execution of team and firm-wide strategic initiatives (“Rocks”).


Career Level Expectations:

  • Demonstrate strong proficiency and reliability in core responsibilities, executing work with minimal oversight, and leveraging firm technology effectively while supporting less experienced team members.
  • Operate with increased autonomy by managing more complex tasks, consistently meeting deadlines, proactively identifying and resolving problems, and demonstrating initiative beyond core responsibilities.
  • Continue to build experience and expand capabilities; maintaining a learning mindset as new responsibilities, skills, and challenges are introduced.


Technical Competencies ("What"):

  • Independently manage client service and operational responsibilities in support of Advisors, Wealth Planning Associates (WPAs), and internal teams, including more complex client transactions, account maintenance, and service-related requests.
  • Coordinate new client onboarding and account setup processes, including client documentation, follow-up activities, adherence to first-year client experience standards, and maintenance of CRM workflows.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for client service and administrative needs, coordinating communication and follow-through across phone, email, and virtual interactions.

  • Coordinate client engagement and relationship-building activities, including client gifts, communications, and other client experience initiatives.
  • Identify and implement improvements to client service processes, administrative workflows, and operational procedures that enhance efficiency and the client experience.
  • Coordinate client service and operational projects, supporting implementation of initiatives that strengthen service delivery and team effectiveness.
  • Deliver a timely, accurate, and high-quality client experience aligned with the firm's client service standards (9.5 or better).

  • Communicate clearly and proactively with team members and stakeholders, using sound judgment when managing more complex work.
  • Collaborate effectively across the team, supporting others and contributing to overall team success.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team environment, while also managing responsibilities independently.
  • Experience coordinating tasks and managing processes, with strong attention to detail.
  • Client-focused approach, with a track record of meeting expectations.
  • Commitment to ongoing professional development and adaptability in a changing industry.

We are a team of good people who put forth relentless effort to serve others.

  • We are a team: we get on the bus, we are dependable and accountable, embrace collaboration, proactively step-up and pitch-in, and we actively help our teammates grow and succeed.
  • Of good people: we are humble, genuine, compassionate, open-minded, positive, and fun to be around.
  • Who put forth relentless effort: we exhibit a can-do spirit, we take initiative, solve problems, go above and beyond and continually improve.
  • To serve others: we listen first, build relationships, anticipate the needs of others, take ownership, and resolve issues – we strive to exceed expectations.

  • Occasional attendance at meeting with outside partners.
  • Travel outside the region may be required for business and/or professional development.
  • In our hybrid work environment, the company reserves the right to modify in-office attendance requirements at its discretion based on business needs.

title: Actuary & Director, PRT Pricing
description:
Job Description:

Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. It's a big ask, but it's one that we have the power to deliver when we work together. We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life, but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it's the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job, it's a career with purpose. It's a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own.


We're actively seeking a talented Director – PRT Pricing to join our Pension Risk Transfer Pricing team. This role is on-site 4 days per week and work from home 1 day per week in Newport Beach, CA, Omaha, NE, or Charlotte, NC.


As a Director – PRT Pricing you'll move Pacific Life, and your career, forward by playing a key role in Pacific Life's growth and long-term success by leading pricing across the end-to-end Pension Risk Transfer (PRT) lifecycle. This is a broad-scope role: rather than owning a single specialty, you will lead transaction pricing and deal execution while flexing across the team's focus areas – assumptions and frameworks, mortality and experience, ALM and reinvestment, and pricing operations – as business needs and capacity require. You will work closely and collaboratively with numerous areas within the Institutional Division and across the enterprise, including Sales, Product, Risk, Enterprise Modeling, Investments, Enterprise ALM, and Valuation.


You will sit on a team of 15 within the Institutional Division. Your colleagues will include actuaries and pricing analysts with varied backgrounds in PRT, ALM, reinsurance, mortality setting, and capital management. The PRT Pricing team works in a fast-paced and constantly evolving marketspace. We value flexibility, agility, and teamwork and complete work in a matrix design to allow for the most efficient resource management.


Candidates who meet most but not all requirements are encouraged to apply. Actual job title and offer will be based on experience and skillset.

Candidates who bring deep PRT market expertise, a strong technical foundation, and the ability to lead teams while driving outcomes through ambiguity will be well positioned to make a meaningful impact in this role.


How you'll help move us forward:

  • Lead PRT Pricing Deal Strategy: Oversee transaction pricing, assumption setting, and bid execution for PRT deals across retiree, deferred, and buy-in structures. Ensure pricing aligns with enterprise risk appetite and profitability goals.
  • Own Cases End to End: Lead and own the full pricing process within the matrix model, operating in both execution and senior reviewer capacities to ensure quality, consistency, and accountability, carrying a portfolio of transactions alongside project work and flexing to where capacity and complexity demand.
  • Breadth Across Pricing Disciplines: Build and apply working depth across the team's focus areas – pricing frameworks (Statutory and Economic) and assumptions, mortality and experience analysis, ALM and reinvestment strategy, and pricing operations – own outcomes across these areas as priorities shift, bringing the connections between them into pricing decisions
  • Assumptions & Methodology: Develop and apply methodology for complex, ambiguous pricing problems, including newly proposed structures or provisions not previously priced. Own assumption updates end to end, and justify methodology decisions, simplifications, and model limitations to technical and executive audiences.
  • Stakeholder Management: Anticipate stakeholder hurdles and secure buy-in ahead of them. Drive decision-making by facilitating alignment across Sales, Capital, Reinsurance, Investments, Valuation, and Risk
  • Team Development: Hire, assess, and develop actuaries, actuarial students, and pricing analysts. Clearly define roles and responsibilities, delegate to the appropriate level, and ensure cross-training and continuity as responsibilities shift.
  • Governance & Documentation: Own the pricing control environment — ensure compliance in standards, documentation, and regulatory support.
  • Innovation & Thought Leadership: Champion new ideas and lead initiatives from ideation to execution, including automation and AI-enabled improvements. Influence working norms and process improvements across the PRT team.

The experience you bring:

  • FSA or EA with 6+ years of related experience in actuarial pricing and product development.
  • Direct experience with Pension Risk Transfer or annuity products.
  • Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Strong management, team-building, and communication skills.
  • Excellent project management and business partnering abilities.
  • Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end initiatives including resourcing decisions and accountability for delivery risk
  • Track record of designing and implementing solutions where no established process existed, and driving them to adoption.
  • Ability to understand the big picture and mobilize initiatives in ambiguous situations.
  • Comfort moving between technical disciplines and picking up unfamiliar subject matter quickly.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Prophet.

What makes you stand out:

  • FSA or EA with 10+ years of actuarial experience.
  • Prior experience with Pension Risk Transfer transaction pricing, including deferred, cash balance, lump sum, and buy-in structures.
  • Experience leading mortality experience analysis (PRT or other business lines), including the development and application of analytical tools, methodologies, and executive-ready insights that translate data into a clear business narrative.
  • Thought leader with a mindset focused on continuous improvement, sustainability, and scalability.
  • Ability to multitask with shifting priorities under tight deadlines while maintaining calm composure and flexibility in handling urgent requests.
  • Self-starter with strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • VBA coding experience and proficiency in related programming languages.
  • Experience with actuarial modeling and statistical analysis programs, particularly Prophet, the Prophet Asset Liability Strategy Library, Alteryx, and R.

  • Omaha, NE: $175,950 - $215,050

title: Toimittaja Jämsän Seutuun
description:
Innostaako sinua journalismi, jota tehdään lähellä lukijaa? Oletko kiinnostunut selvittämään arjen ilmiöitä ja paikallisten ihmisten tarinoita? Haluatko olla mukana luomassa ja ylläpitämässä työskentelypaikkakuntasi identiteettiä, sananvapautta ja demokratiaa? Jos vastasit kyllä, tule Jämsään!


Etsimme toimittajaa määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Jämsän Seutuun 4.1.–31.12.2027.

Jämsä on noin 19 000 ihmisen kaupunki, joka tunnetaan esimerkiksi metsä- ja prosessiteollisuudestaan sekä Himoksen alueen matkailusta. Kaupunki elää tällä hetkellä elinkeinoelämän murroksen aikoja, joten uutisoitava ei lopu kesken. Kaupunkiin suunnitellaan esimerkiksi useampaa datakeskusta ja vihreän energian hanketta. Lisäksi Jämsän Hallissa toimiva Patrian F-35-hävittäjien kokoonpano sekä muut ilmailu- ja puolustusalan yritykset luovat mielenkiintoa alueelle.


Jämsän Seutu tarjoaa jämsäläisille ajankohtaisia puheenaiheita verkossa, sovelluksessa ja kerran viikossa ilmestyvässä painetussa lehdessä. Lisäksi osa verkossa julkaistavista jutuista julkaistaan kerran viikossa ilmestyvässä kaupunkilehti Vekkarissa.


Toimittajana pääset osallistumaan laajasti lehden tekoon. Juttujen ideoimisen, kirjoittamisen ja kuvaamisen lisäksi pääset tekemään digitaalista mediaa videoista ja livelähetyksistä aina verkkojuttujen rikasteisiin. Analytiikka on keskeinen osa onnistumistemme arviointia.


Työssä onnistuminen edellyttää aiempaa kokemusta journalistisessa mediassa. Työkokemuksen lisäksi arvostamme erityisesti halua oppia uusia työvälineitä ja työn tekemisen muotoja sekä innokkuutta jalkautua jämsäläisten sekaan tekemään journalismia. Toivomme sinulta hyvää valokuvaustaitoa tai halua kehittää osaamistasi.


Työtä tehdään Jämsässä ja tarpeen mukaan välillä myös etänä. Työhön kuuluu jonkin verran ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroja. Ajokortti ja oma auto ovat työssä välttämättömiä.


Kuulumme Sanoman alueelliseen toimitusyhteisöön useiden muiden mediabrändien kanssa. Meillä olet osa huippuammattilaisten verkostoa. Yhdessä toimien varmistamme kukin yleisöllemme palvelun, johon kuuluu lähes ympärivuorokautinen uutispäivystys.


Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään 4.11.2026. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

Olemme mukana ihmisten arjessa ja juhlassa, vaikutamme valintoihin ja käsitykseen maailmasta, autamme yrityksiä menestymään. Sillä on merkitystä.

Meillä on isot, kaikkien tuntemat mediabrändit ja joukko maan suurimpia digipalveluja. Sanoman mediat tavoittavat 97 % suomalaisista joka viikko.

Sanomalla työtä tehdään asiakas edellä, datan pohjalta, fiksusti, vastuullisesti ja yhdessä. Meillä jokaisella on tilaa kehittyä, toimia ja olla oma itsensä. Tavoitteenamme on monimuotoinen, yhdenvertainen ja osallistava työpaikka.

Function / Position Summary

The Multi Abilities Classroom (MAC) paraeducator supports the classroom by assisting in the implementation of structured instructional, behavioral, social and communication supports aligned to the MAC curriculum and practices. Provide direct support to students with significant academic learning, communication and behavioral needs, including assistance with personal care, feeding and toileting as required. Perform duties under the direct supervision of a certified staff member, contribute to a consistent, hands on and supportive learning environment while maintaining confidentiality of student, staff and department information.

Job Duties / Responsibilities

  • Implement individual or small group instructional activities under the direction of the MAC teacher, using established routines, visual supports and structured practices.
  • Familiarize yourself with student IEP goals, objectives, accommodations and behavior supports to assist with consistent implementation across the school day.
  • Support the use of communication systems, visual schedules, reinforcement systems and other structured supports that align with MAC expectations and individual student needs.
  • Follow through on defined behavioral intervention plans and procedures, including implementation of proactive strategies, reinforcement systems and de-escalation supports as directed by the teacher.
  • Assist with data collection, including academic, behavioral, social and communication data, and document information as requested by the teacher.
  • Support a structured classroom environment by preparing, organizing and maintaining materials and assisting with environmental setup as directed by the teacher.
  • Supervise students during lunch, recess, arrival, departure and community-based activities.
  • Escort students within the building, including transitions to specials/electives, therapies and other instructional spaces.
  • Assist with the loading and unloading of student buses during assigned work hours.
  • Work cooperatively with the teacher by assisting with any activity aligned to student IEP needs, including instructional tasks, communication supports, social skills and behavior routines.
  • Provide personal care support to students, including lifting, transferring, positioning, feeding, toileting and hygiene needs, consistent with special skills expectations.
  • Support students in building independence, communication, self-regulation and engagement throughout the school day.
  • Provide input to the teacher regarding student responses, communication attempts, behavior patterns and other needs.
  • Attend staff meetings and professional development activities as assigned.
  • Maintain confidentiality of student, staff and department information within the school and community.
  • Be willing to complete and maintain certification in CPI and Ukeru to support safe, proactive approaches to behavior support.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education

  • Para Educator, Substitute, Professional Educator or Provisional Educator License required.
  • Minimum education requirement for a Para Educator license is completion of at least 60 semester hours of college coursework or a passing score on the ETS Para Pro exam or two specific Work Keys exams.
  • Bilingual ? Spanish/English (written/verbal) preferred.
  • Assignments in multi-lingual or bilingual classrooms require Bilingual-Spanish/English.

Experience / Knowledge

  • 3 years of Para Educator experience or classroom assistant for students with disabilities preferred.
  • Experience with students who have behavioral needs preferred.
  • Experience as a Behavior technician or Registered Behavior Technician strongly preferred.
  • Ability to collaborate with staff and students in a way that is collaborative, student-friendly and productive.
  • Familiarity with data collection preferred.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work through many interruptions throughout the school day.
  • Required prolonged standing, bending, start/stop and sitting.
  • Lifting may be required to manually move, carry, pull or push heavy objects or materials.
  • Assisting with toileting needs may be required as needed.
  • Ability to perform CPI-approved restraint once trained.
  • Excellent physical agility and quick response time.

Responsible for developing and maintaining Professional Customer relationships and program growth. Is accountable for achieving financial metrics and maintaining service and appearance standards. Position is exempt and requires a minimum of 50-55 hours per week (excluding meal break periods). The average schedule is 5-6 days a week, 11 hour shifts, including rotating nights and weekends, with an hour for lunch. Additional hours may be required based on staffing, store conditions, sales to target, and other business demands. General Managers are required to work a schedule based on the needs of the business.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Achieve overall store sales goals and service objectives
  • Manage and grow Professional Customer relationships/sales, including building and holding team accountable to executing Customer action plans
  • Selection, hiring, development, performance mgmt., coaching, scheduling and engagement of store Team Members
  • Ensure execution of all inventory and operational standards
  • Coach all Team Members to deliver on Customer expectations (DIY and Professional)
  • Manager on duty responsibilities (touch base/coaching, floor/phone mgmt., task assignment and completion, safety, open/close duties)
  • Ability to lead change management
  • Embrace diversity and foster a respectful environment for both Customers and Team Members

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Provide DIY service including battery installation, testing, wiper install, etc.
  • Assist District/Region in other functions upon request

Success Factors

  • Friendly communication
  • Ability to locate and stock parts
  • Safety knowledge and skills
  • Ability to become ASE P2 certified or ASE ready equivalent
  • Ability to execute and train project and product quality recommendations
  • Advanced parts lookup and sourcing
  • Ability to source from numerous places including special order, FDO, second source, etc.
  • Ability to execute and train all store operational processes and procedures, and testing and diagnostic equipment for DIY services
  • Ability to execute and train inventory systems and store equipment
  • Ability to execute and train POS and Parts lookup systems
  • Ability to review and analyze P&L statement
  • Ability to recruit, select, hire and develop quality Team Members
  • Ability to build and grow relationships with Professional Customers

Essential Job Skills Necessary for Success as a General Manager

  • Working knowledge of automotive systems preferred
  • Speak and write English (Spanish a plus); communicate effectively and build strong relationships with Customers, peers and upper management
  • Use Microsoft software effectively (Word, Excel required; PowerPoint preferred)
  • Calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, percentages, sales increases, and gross profit percent
  • Ability to review and analyze business reports, such as profit and loss statement (P&L)
  • Hold others accountable, inspect work quality and give feedback in a way that is inspiring
  • Ability to work an assortment of days, evenings and weekends as needed
  • Prior Experience that Sets a General Manager up for Success
  • 2-3 years of experience managing a team of 10 - 20 Team Members in a fast-paced and highly dynamic retail environment
  • Successful experience managing profitability; proven financial and business acumen

Education

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED), Bachelor’s degree in business or a related area preferred.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

  • Must have a valid driver's license
  • ASE certification preferred, but not required

Physical Demands

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will predominantly be walking or standing. The employee is required to be able to talk and hear, and use hands and fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is usually working inside; however, they will occasionally be outside and exposed to various weather conditions while performing such tasks as installing batteries and wiper blades. The employee is also occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; risk of electrical shock; explosives; and vibration. title: Client Account Sr Manager (DHS)
description:
The AECOM Government Business Line is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Client Account Sr Manager to enhance our partnership with DHS.

AECOM has a longstanding and multifaceted relationship with the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS), providing a wide range of services that support DHS's mission across various components.

Client Account Managers are the primary contacts for AECOM's relationships with accounts which are strategically important at a regional, business line or global level. They have responsibility for developing, growing and sustaining our business with their client(s), working across our company to offer solutions that deliver, using all our relevant capabilities and local and global expertise. Bringing the best of AECOM to the client, on time, every time.

This will be a hybrid position including a combination of both remote and on-site work schedules, that can be based in, but not limited to: Arlington, VA; Baltimore, MD; Germantown, MD; Washington D.C.

Job Summary

Primary contact and leader for AECOM’s relationship with a one or more large Regional accounts or part of a team supporting a key Global or Regional account. Responsible for developing, growing and sustaining AECOMs business for assigned accounts. Coordinates AECOMs interactions with the client, to ensure consistent high quality of service and to resolve any delivery issues or conflicts.


Talent Developer - Encourages diverse and inclusive collaboration leveraging AECOM’s global footprint to enable individual growth and collective success through trust, autonomy, accountability, and alignment.

When developing others:

  • Connects team to the client vision and ensures team is client-focused and that our clients get the best AECOM experience every time.
  • Coaches and supports other team members in building strong relationships across the organization.
  • Supports the attraction and retention of business development talent.


Highly Accountable - Delivers results and leads others to do the same; effectively managing risk to lead through change and ambiguity advancing AECOM’s vision, purpose and strategies

When focused on delivery:

  • Accountable for meeting key business plan objectives for their client portfolio.
  • Monitor client projects to ensure high quality delivery, technical excellence and consistent client service experience.
  • Identifies risks and manages project delivery to mitigate impact.
  • Demonstrated ability to set short and medium term goals and strategies for the account to align with the client’s needs.
  • Identifies evolving resourcing needs for client portfolio.


Industry Standout - Establishes self as a strategic, collaborative leader and in areas of expertise in field, market or with clients.

When representing AECOM externally:

  • Recognized by their clients as a primary contact with AECOM.
  • Has strong market and technical knowledge, which is relevant to their client responsibilities.


When representing AECOM internally:

  • Known as the key point of contact for the client and for opportunities across specific market sectors.
  • Building a strong network within their Region or Global business line.
  • Demonstrates the ability to influence leadership to ensure their clients’ issues are prioritized.


When inspiring innovation:

  • Works with Regional Business Line and Market Sector Leaders to identify new business opportunities.
  • Understands and responds to business trends in their area of expertise.
  • Encourages adoption of key AECOM initiatives such as ESG and digitalization.


Client Builder - Has a deep understanding of client priorities and is client-focused, connects team to their vision, ensuring they provide the best AECOM experience every time.

When building client/stakeholder relationships:

  • Is the relationship lead or part of the account management team for one or more of AECOM’s strategically important accounts.
  • Has identified and is building a strong relationship with key stakeholders within assigned areas of client responsibility.
  • Takes the initiative to manage AECOM’s response where client or project issues are identified.


When building AECOM’s reputation:

  • Demonstrates strong leadership attributes that provide role modelling for others.
  • Champion for ethical and safe working practices.
  • Integrates AECOM and client values to positively impact AECOM’s wider reputation.


When executing our growth strategy:

  • Drives growth in pipeline of potential projects.
  • Coordinates the capture of significant new business opportunities and the renewal/extension of existing large-scale agreements .
  • Liaises with Market Sector and Regional teams to identify growth opportunities.


When focused on our commercial business:

  • Manages consistent approaches to working with the client.
  • Demonstrates good understand of commercial elements of contracts (financial, legal and governance).
  • Collaborates across Regions and business lines to build consensus on commercial terms.
  • Balances client and AECOM priorities.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in architecture, engineering or other related discipline and 10+ years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education including at least 2 years of leadership.
  • Prior experience with DHS and the ability to effectively navigate relationships within the organization is essential.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with multifunctional teams.

Highly Desirable Qualifications:

description:
Position: QA Engineer (Manual & API)
Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)
Contract Type: Full-time, Permanent
Time Zone Alignment: North American Business Hours (EST / CT / PT)

🧭 About Inallmedia.com

Inallmedia.com is a global technology and design firm focused on building impactful digital solutions through remote, distributed teams across LATAM. We partner with international clients across industries, providing long-term technical expertise, product innovation, and team augmentation.

🚀 Project Overview

You will join a fast-paced, collaborative Agile team focused on the quality assurance and platform reliability of a high-impact, web-based SaaS platform. This ecosystem features both user-facing interfaces and complex backend integration layers. Your primary focus will be verifying core functional workflows, API integrations, data integrity, and digital accessibility compliance (WCAG). Operating within a modern technical ecosystem—including RESTful APIs, asynchronous event-driven workflows, and CI/CD pipelines—you will align closely with Software Engineering, Product Management, and Technical Support to ensure flawless product releases.

🔍 Key Responsibilities

  • Quality Assurance Execution & Functional Testing: Plan, design, and execute end-to-end (E2E) manual test scenarios, functional tests, and regression suites to ensure platform stability following new deployments and feature releases.
  • API & Backend Validation: Perform API testing and backend service integration validation using Postman; verify system responses, data structures, and contract compliance across RESTful services.
  • Database & Data Verification: Execute relational database queries (SQL) to perform data validation, investigate defects, troubleshoot data flow issues, and verify backend state changes.
  • Accessibility & Compliance Testing: Perform accessibility audits and feature testing in compliance with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) standards using standard accessibility tooling.
  • Defect Management & Reporting: Document, track, and manage bugs, test executions, and workflow anomalies in Jira; ensure end-to-end traceability from product requirements to resolution.
  • Cross-Functional Agile Collaboration: Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives), translating business requirements and product specifications into comprehensive test strategies.
  • Log Analysis & Monitoring: Inspect application logs and system events during test execution to isolate root causes of performance or functional bottlenecks.

💡 Must-Have Skills

  • Experience Level: 3–5 years of professional QA experience with a strong focus on manual testing, validating end-to-end workflows, and user functionality.
  • Test Strategy & Execution: Proven ability to interpret product needs, identify business problems, and translate them into effective testing scenarios, validation plans, and regression suites.
  • API Testing: Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, validating backend integrations/services, and verifying responses using Postman.
  • Database & SQL Proficiency: Strong SQL skills for backend data validation, troubleshooting, and test verification.
  • Defect Management: Extensive experience documenting defects, test results, and workflow issues using Jira.
  • Accessibility Standards: Practical experience with WCAG standards and utilizing accessibility testing tooling.
  • Agile Methodology: Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, actively participating in sprint cycles, testing ceremonies, and release validation.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, and Support.
  • Log & System Monitoring: Experience using Datadog for log review, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Event-Driven Systems: Familiarity with Kafka and asynchronous workflow validation.
  • NoSQL Databases: Exposure to MongoDB or other NoSQL databases for backend data validation.
  • Deployment Operations: General understanding of CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and release validation activities.
  • Domain Background: Prior experience working with SaaS platforms or complex customer-facing/employer-facing applications.

🌐 Time Zone & Collaboration The role is fully remote within LATAM.

Collaboration and alignment with standard North American business hours are required to ensure seamless integration with the core engineering and product teams.

💬 Language All interviews, documentation, and daily communication will be in English.

title: Product Information & Compliance Specialist (Mandarin Preferred)
description:
Position Overview

This position manages product information, reviews packaging compliance, and controls regulatory risks throughout the company’s product development and launch process. The goal is to ensure that products comply with applicable laws, regulations, and internal standards from initial documentation and packaging design through importation and sale. Core duties include organizing and maintaining basic product data such as product name, specifications, ingredients, materials, net contents, country of origin, manufacturer, and warnings; applying for, generating, assigning, and tracking UPC barcodes; and providing the design, procurement, and supply chain teams with accurate, complete, ready-to-use product information.

The specialist also reviews packaging copy, label information, and legally required declarations for accuracy, completeness, and compliance. The role assesses regulatory requirements for food, cosmetics, general merchandise, and other categories, including but not limited to FDA food labeling and safety requirements, allergen declarations, nutrition information, import declarations, and related documentation. The specialist must continuously identify and flag potential compliance risks, coordinate corrective actions with suppliers, the Product Design Manager, and relevant departments, and take professional responsibility for final review conclusions and regulatory assessments.


Job Responsibilities

1.Product Information and Specification Management

Collect, verify, and organize basic product information, including product name, specifications, dimensions, net contents, ingredients, materials, country of origin, manufacturer, shelf life, storage conditions, instructions for use, and warnings. Establish standardized product records and ensure that data sources are clear, fields are complete, versions are consistent, and accurate information is shared promptly with design, procurement, supply chain, and other relevant teams.

2.UPC Barcode and Product Code Management

Apply for, generate, assign, register, and maintain UPC barcodes. Maintain a complete UPC register and ensure each SKU is correctly matched to its barcode. Review barcode numbers, dimensions, placement, and scannability in packaging files to prevent duplicate use, incorrect assignment, or version confusion.


3.Packaging Copy and Label Review

Review product names, claims and selling points, ingredients, specifications, net contents, nutrition information, allergen statements, directions for use, warnings, responsible-party details, and other legally required information on packaging. Ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Proofread packaging artwork for compliance and provide the product design team with clear revision instructions and final review conclusions.


4,Laws, Regulations, and Product Compliance Review

Research and implement the laws, regulatory standards, and labeling requirements applicable in the product’s sales markets. Review product formulas, ingredients, packaging information, marketing claims, and conditions of sale for compliance. Focus areas include FDA food safety, food labeling, nutrition facts, allergens, food additives, cosmetics, and other relevant category requirements. Take appropriate responsibility for professional review conclusions.


5.Import Compliance and Supplier Documentation Review

Review manufacturer information, ingredient lists, test reports, qualification certificates, country-of-origin information, and other documents required for imported products. Work with procurement, supply chain, and customs-broker personnel to confirm that products meet U.S. import and sales requirements. Promptly request corrective action for missing documentation, conflicting information, or potential violations, and follow up with suppliers on supplements or corrections.


6.Compliance Risk Management and Cross-functional Collaboration

Identify compliance risks throughout product development, packaging, importation, and sales; maintain an issue list and follow corrective actions through closure. Collaborate with the Product Design Manager, Product Designer, procurement, supply chain, operations, and external suppliers. Communicate regulatory requirements, review conclusions, and risk items promptly. Escalate major issues or matters that cannot be independently assessed, and coordinate with external specialists or legal counsel when appropriate.


Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher preferred in food science, food safety, nutrition, regulatory affairs, quality management, supply chain management, international trade, law, or a related field. Candidates with relevant experience in food, cosmetics, or consumer goods may be considered even if their degree is in another field.
  • Professional Experience: At least 2 years of relevant experience in product compliance, regulatory affairs, food safety, quality management, label review, product information management, or import operations. Familiarity with the process from document collection and packaging review through sampling, production, importation, and launch is required. U.S.-market compliance experience with food, cosmetics, or general merchandise is preferred.
  • Knowledge & Skills: Familiarity with organizing and reviewing packaging information such as product details, ingredient lists, nutrition facts, allergens, net contents, country of origin, responsible-party information, and warnings. Knowledge of FDA food safety and labeling requirements, food imports, and basic customs declaration rules, with the ability to research and interpret applicable regulations continuously. Familiarity with UPC application, assignment, and register maintenance; strong Excel, document organization, and version-control skills. Able to handle supplier documentation and regulatory files in both Chinese and English.
  • Core Competencies: Strong accuracy, accountability, and risk awareness; ability to identify conflicting information, missing documentation, and potential compliance issues. Clear reasoning and the ability to translate complex regulations into specific, actionable review comments. Strong cross-functional communication and project coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with product design, procurement, supply chain, suppliers, and external specialists. Able to uphold standards, escalate significant risks promptly, and drive issues to closure.


Compensation

  • $28-$30 per hour
  • Quarterly Performance Bonus: This position is eligible for a quarterly performance-based bonus, subject to the eligibility requirements, performance criteria, and terms of the Company's bonus program.


Benefits

  • 401(k) & 401(k) matching - subject to the eligibility requirements
  • Paid Sick Leave
  • Employee discount
  • Health insurance
  • Paid Time Off


Language Requirement: Proficiency in English and Mandarin is preferred

Job Type: Full-Time (On-Site)

title: Tecnico Mecanico
description:
Job Description:

Técnico Mecánico

Durán, Guayas, Ecuador

¿Por qué unirse a nosotros?

Prepárate para ser el protagonista de tu carrera como Técnico Mecánico en Skretting, una empresa de Nutreco. Como líderes mundiales en nutrición animal, nuestro objetivo es «Alimentar el futuro». Sé protagonista de tu dirección, de tu desarrollo y de tu camino.

Lo que harás

Serás responsable de ejecutar el mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo de los equipos mecánicos de nuestra planta de balanceados, asegurando su correcto funcionamiento y la continuidad de la operación. Trabajarás en la inspección, reparación y ajuste de equipos como elevadores, transportadores, peletizadoras (pellets), molinos y válvulas rotativas, contribuyendo a mantener altos estándares de seguridad, confiabilidad y eficiencia en los procesos productivos.

Principales responsabilidades:

  • Ejecutar mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos de los equipos mecánicos de la planta.
  • Diagnosticar y solucionar fallas mecánicas para minimizar tiempos de parada.
  • Realizar inspecciones periódicas a elevadores, transportadores, molinos, peletizadoras y válvulas rotativas.
  • Ejecutar cambios, ajustes y reparaciones de componentes mecánicos.
  • Cumplir con los procedimientos de seguridad, calidad y mantenimiento establecidos.
  • Registrar las actividades de mantenimiento realizadas y reportar oportunidades de mejora.
  • Trabajar en coordinación con los equipos de Producción y Mantenimiento para garantizar la disponibilidad de los equipos.

A quién buscamos

Buscamos una persona proactiva, orientada a la resolución de problemas y con un fuerte compromiso con la seguridad y la calidad. Valoramos perfiles con capacidad para trabajar en equipo, disposición para aprender y experiencia en mantenimiento mecánico dentro de plantas industriales, preferiblemente del sector de alimentos balanceados.

Requisitos

  • Tecnólogo o Técnico en Mecánica Industrial, Electromecánica, Mantenimiento Industrial o carreras afines.
  • 2 años mínimo de experiencia en mantenimiento mecánico de plantas industriales.
  • Experiencia en mantenimiento de elevadores, transportadores, molinos, peletizadoras (pellets) y válvulas rotativas.
  • Conocimientos en mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo de equipos industriales.
  • Disponibilidad para trabajar en turnos rotativos, de ser requerido.
  • Deseable experiencia en plantas de alimentos balanceados o industrias de procesos continuos.

Lo que recibirás

Como parte de Nutreco, formarás parte de la familia SHV, un grupo global y diverso de empresas que ofrece amplias oportunidades profesionales. Tendrás acceso a experiencia internacional y trayectorias profesionales, respaldadas por la estabilidad y el enfoque a largo plazo de una de las empresas privadas más grandes del mundo.

Además, recibirás:

  • Seguro médico privado.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Alimentación.
  • Más beneficios.

    Cómo y por qué saber más

Podemos ofrecerte una carrera con verdadero significado y propósito, donde te sentirás orgulloso de lo que haces cada día y del papel que desempeñas en Alimentar el Futuro. Si te interesa unirte a nosotros, prepárate para asumir tu desarrollo, tu potencial y tu carrera. Nuestro objetivo es revisar todas las solicitudes en un plazo de cinco días laborables y nos pondremos en contacto contigo lo antes posible.

Ruder Finn is seeking a highly qualified Vice President (VP) to join our Relate team. This leadership role will focus on managing complex communications needs in a highly visible and dynamic environment, serving as a key partner to the clients and within our agency team.


The ideal candidate will bring a proven track record in high-stakes communications, be well-versed in the regulatory and media landscape, and demonstrate a passion for delivering impactful strategies under pressure.

  • Exceptional writing, presentation, and verbal communication skills

title: Licensed Clinical Supervisor
description:
San Diego Youth ServicesJOB ANNOUNCEMENTLicensed Clinical Supervisor

San Diego Youth Services seeks a Licensed Clinical Supervisor in the Quality Management department to be based in San Diego. This is a full-time & exempt position reporting to the Quality Management Manager.


San Diego Youth Services: Who we are


San Diego Youth Services has helped improve the lives of more than 834,000 homeless, runaway and vulnerable youth since its beginning in 1970. We provide safe places to live and long-term solutions through shelter, foster homes, community centers and housing to more than 16,000 youth every year at 100+ community and school locations. Through prevention, early intervention and treatment, we also help youth before they need higher levels of care or become homeless.


We aim to:

  1. Meet the basic needs of youth. Hunger, poverty and youth homelessness are on the rise for many youth and their families today. We help meet these basic needs for youth. What could be more vital than food and shelter? We provide safe places to live and long-term solutions through shelter, foster homes, community centers and housing.
  2. Create positive connection. We help youth focus on positive life changes and healthy relationships as part of providing needed resources and services. San Diego Youth Services has long provided foster homes and adoption support services for families considering adopting a youth in the foster care system.
  3. Help youth develop life skills. In addition to a range of safe and stable housing options, we offer support to help youth develop the independent living skills necessary to become self-sufficient and keep off the streets.
  4. Promote overall health and well-being. Early intervention and care for the whole child are critical. We provide a broad continuum of services to help youth overcome trauma and challenges that put them at risk, including case management, counseling, mental health treatment and educational support and resources.

SDYS has a staff of approximately 250 employees and 80 volunteers working across San Diego County and an annual budget of approximately $24 million.


You can learn more about us at .


CONTEXT OF THE POSITION:


The Licensed Clinical Supervisor reports to the Director of Quality Management for day-to-day clinical oversight and operations. Responsible for the development and maintenance of an integrated treatment approach for youth with co-occurring mental health and substance disorders and quality trauma-informed youth and family services, including overall supervision of the contracted components. The clinical supervisor is responsible for providing clinical supervision for program staff, clinical staff, trainees/interns, and volunteers. This position coordinates and monitors clinical oversight, training, supervision, quality assurance and quality improvement of documentation standards, relationships with placement universities, county partners, and other clinical administrative functions. Clinical Supervisor will work collaboratively with Program Managers and Directors of Service as part of Record Review and provide clinical oversight for assigned programs.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  1. The development, implementation, and evaluation of an integrated treatment approach for youth and families with co-occurring mental health and substance disorders and quality trauma informed youth programs that adhere to and uphold the rigorous standards of San Diego Youth Services as mandated by its mission, purpose, guiding principles and standards of quality.
  2. Facilitates application, interview, and assignment process of agency trainees/interns.
  3. Train, embrace and manage volunteers in the organization as applicable.
  4. Provides individual and group clinical supervision on a weekly basis and as needed.
  5. Utilizes co-therapy, live supervision, and audio/visual methods for teaching and supervision as required.
  6. Available on call to consult with staff on clinical emergencies, including but not limited to any safety, legal or ethical issues.
  7. Provides consultation to program managers and attends treatment teams.
  8. Is part of the Training team who develops and facilitates trainings to agency staff, and volunteers.
  9. Assists with client assignments, monitors case progress from intake to termination.
  10. Conducts weekly quality assurance and quality improvement reviews to ensure that staff, trainee/interns, and volunteers are following documentation standards.
  11. Performs Record Reviews in EHRs used by agency and participates in audits and county meetings as appropriate.
  12. Performs clinical youth and family assessments as requested audits as appropriate.
  13. Performs clinical youth and family assessments as requested
  14. Monitors service delivery and contract administration, as needed.
  15. Maintains outreach and collaborations with schools, law enforcement, child protective services, alternative sites, mental health practitioners, local psychiatrists, hospital in-patient providers and other providers as needed.
  16. Responsible for implementing projects consistent with community health and agency direction.
  17. Participates in staff meetings and trainings as assigned.
  18. Maintains written and statistical reports on program activity.

title: Business Analytics Intern
description:
The Client & Customer Experience (C&CE) team is responsible for the servicing of Cigna customers across multiple lines of business, including US Medical, Pharmacy Benefits, and more. C&CE owns the delivery of exceptional client and customer experience while operating Cigna’s call centers effectively and efficiently for the business. During the internship, the associate will work closely with operational partners to deeply understand 1-2 assigned business case projects, develop analytical insights and build/share compelling presentations that positively influence future strategy.

  • Develop 1-2 business cases that evaluate options and assess costs/benefits to guide prioritization decisions
  • Leverage data to solve business problems by identifying data needs, pulling data from relevant sources, and performing analysis
  • Identify business opportunities using trend analysis and mining operational data for insights
  • Distill work into crisp presentations that educate, inform, and inspire action

  • Strategy – Influence action through data-driven analysis and business acumen. Identify and assess potential opportunities for change over the next 3-5 years.
  • Business Judgment – Develop and use frameworks to scope and address ambiguous problems. Understand where the leverage is and focus problem-solving efforts to uncover insights that drive action.

  • Data – Ground analysis in data as much as possible. Define needs, identify data sources, ensure data quality, and partner with data teams to complete analysis. Coding experience in a relevant language (e.g. SQL or Python) is a preference.
  • Communications – Influence leaders across C&CE and our stakeholder teams. Distill complex analytical work into key insights, recommendations, and next steps.

  • Rising senior working towards a Bachelor’s degree (Business Analytics, Business, Economics, Math, Statistics or related field preferred)
  • Strong communication (oral and written), presentation, and facilitation skills
  • Ability to structure project plans and independently manage to deadlines

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced knowledge of data analysis and visualization tools (e.g. Excel, SQL, Tableau)
  • Proficiency in an analytics-focused coding language, e.g. SQL, Python, or R
  • Experience with building, managing, or using business models, e.g. optimization, predictive analysis, or financial / credit modeling

Therefore, this temporary internship is open only to individuals who are eligible for employment in the United States and who would not require visa support including H-1B, CPT/OPT/STEM, etc., now or in the future.
