title: Senior Integration Specialist
description:
Are you a senior integration professional who thrives at the intersection of technical architecture and enterprise delivery? As a Senior Integration Specialist at Ledcor, you will serve as a subject-matter authority on our enterprise integration ecosystem — co-designing complex integration solutions, driving platform optimization, and providing technical leadership across high-impact initiatives. You will work hands-on with platforms including Boomi, Solace, AWS, and Azure to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient integrations that connect Ledcor's on-premises and cloud systems.



Reporting to the Manager, Integration and Automation Services, you will collaborate closely with Solution Architects, Business Systems Analysts, Product Owners, and delivery teams to ensure integration solutions align with long-term architectural roadmaps and business goals. With 8+ years of experience in integration and API development, you bring the depth to lead design reviews, establish enterprise standards, mentor developers, and serve as an escalation point for complex production issues — all while championing continuous improvement across our integration practice.



Come and join the True Blue team and build your career with one of Canada's most established construction companies.


Essential Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and delivery of complex, enterprise-grade integration solutions — collaborating with Solution Architects to define patterns, uphold security standards, and ensure performance expectations are met across on-premises and cloud environments
  • Drive platform-wide optimization of Boomi, Solace, Azure, AWS, and related technologies, identifying opportunities for reuse, standardization, and modernization to strengthen the overall integration ecosystem
  • Translate high-level business strategies and multi-system dependencies into robust integration designs and solution roadmaps, advising senior stakeholders on technical trade-offs, risks, and architectural considerations
  • Lead design reviews and provide authoritative technical guidance to integration developers, business analysts, and project teams — establishing integration standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the organization
  • Conduct technical assessments for new integration initiatives, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, domain models, bounded contexts, and security and compliance policies
  • Oversee integration testing strategies and champion CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and DevOps practices to improve reliability, quality, and speed of integration delivery
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex production issues impacting cross-system integrations, leading root cause analysis, guiding teams through advanced troubleshooting, and driving long-term improvements to integration reliability and observability
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and provide recommendations to enhance integration capabilities, mentoring developers in integration best practices and contributing to a culture of continuous learning and improvement

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of integration and/or API development experience, including 5+ years of hands-on work with enterprise integration platforms such as Boomi, Solace, AWS, or Azure
  • 7+ years working within enterprise application ecosystems, with experience across systems such as Oracle JD Edwards, Workday, or comparable ERP and cloud platforms
  • 5+ years designing integration architecture and reusable patterns, including domain-based and bounded-context data models; experience with canonical data modeling for data lakes is a strong asset
  • Expert-level proficiency with REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, RAML, WSDL, and API testing frameworks, with deep knowledge of event-driven, pub/sub, microservices, and asynchronous messaging topologies
  • Advanced SDLC and DevOps experience, including CI/CD pipeline management, automated testing frameworks, monitoring tools, and agile delivery practices
  • College diploma or technical certification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is required; a bachelor's degree is preferred; Solace and/or Boomi certifications are highly desirable, and cloud architecture certifications (AWS, Azure, Google) are considered an asset
  • Strong technical communication and documentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex integration concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and influence decisions at a senior stakeholder level
  • Experience mentoring integration developers, leading technical reviews, and contributing to the elevation of team capability and enterprise integration standards

Work Environment

  • Hybrid role with flexibility to work from home and in the office; occasional travel may be required (estimated less than 25% of time)
  • Collaborative, cross-functional environment with regular engagement across Solution Architects, Product Owners, Integration Developers, QA Analysts, Application Managers, and external platform partners and vendor architects

Compensation

$94,400.00 - $129,800.00

This is the expected base pay range for this role. Individual base pay will be determined based on a variety of factors including experience, knowledge, skills, education and location.

Our competitive total rewards package provides compensation and benefits that support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. We offer exciting, challenging work with opportunities to develop your skills and knowledge.

Additional Information

The Ledcor Group of Companies is one of North America’s most diversified construction companies. Ledcor is a company built on a rich history of long-standing project successes.

Our workplace culture has been recognized as one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and a Top 100 Inspiring Workplace in North America.

Employment Equity

At Ledcor we believe diversity, equity, and inclusion should be part of everything we do. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status or any other identifying characteristic are encouraged to apply.

Our True Blue team consists of individuals from all backgrounds who contribute diverse perspectives and experiences to Ledcor. We are committed to continuing to build on our culture of empowerment, inclusion and belonging.

Adjustments will be provided in all parts of our hiring process. Applicants need to make their needs known in advance by submitting a request via email. For more information about Ledcor’s Inclusion and Diversity initiatives, please visit our I&D page.

title: Environmental Monitoring Technician I
description:
Why Patients Need You

Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our science and risk-based compliant quality culture is flexible, innovative, and customer oriented. Whether you are involved in development, maintenance, compliance or analysis through research programs, your contribution will directly impact patients.


What You Will Achieve

You will be a team member who is relied upon to have a good understanding of procedures, techniques, tools, materials and equipment. Your decision making will help you prioritize workflows based on the available resources. You will follow standard procedures to complete tasks, some of which may vary in scope, sequence, complexity and timing. You will contribute to the team’s success by sharing your previously acquired knowledge.


It is your hard work and focus that will make Pfizer ready to achieve new milestones and help patients across the globe.


How You Will Achieve It


Perform environmental monitoring in a safe, compliant, and efficient. The job responsibilities include performing environmental monitoring in the Aseptic Manufacturing Environment in order to ensure that our products meet the highest standards of quality.


Key Tasks:

  • Gain an understanding of cGMPs, GLPs EHS and site/ department policies and environmental monitoring concepts.
  • Perform all routine weekly/monthly sampling activities at the site including viable, non-viable, water, ISO and batch process environmental monitoring.
  • Enter and verify environmental monitoring data into various databases/computerized systems and review associated documentation in an accurate and in a timely manner.
  • Author and review monthly/annual data reports.
  • Ensure environmental monitoring supplies are ready and available within the Aseptic Processing Area (APA) and in the QC Laboratory. Support of production/manufacturing team members as business partners working in the APA.
  • Become qualified on aseptic gowning and participate in a successful media filling operation.
  • Consistently demonstrate proper documentation practices.
  • Perform and document aseptic observations and coaching of Manufacturing Operators per the site aseptic practices program.

Work practices and processes will meet the following expectations:

  • Must maintain and neat and tidy workspace.
  • Consistently adheres to company, site and laboratory safety rules and immediately raises any safety observations, concerns or suggestions.
  • Follow company, site and global procedures at all times adopting cGMP, cGDP practices.
  • Follows management direction at all times.
  • Able to function independently while asking questions without hesitation when needed or unsure.
  • Accepts dynamic work sequences and schedule changes.
  • Position is a 1st shift position requiring schedule flexibility including the need to work weekends when required by the manufacturing schedule.

Planning, Communication, Teamwork, Initiative and Performance Expectations:

  • Actively participates in daily and weekly planning discussions among teammates and Management (as needed) offering suggestions to improve RFT and Manufacturing Schedule support as needed.
  • Consistently communicates work sequence status in a timely manner.
  • Where work was not achieved, actively participates in discussions to identify opportunities for correction and improvement.
  • Demonstrates engagement in helping to achieve QC Team, individual as well as site goals.
  • When faced with roadblocks or issues, routinely offers suggestions for improvements.
  • Maintains a positive influence on the QC Team, often going out of his/her way to support and assist teammates across different shifts as necessary.

Qualifications

  • Qualification and Requirements:
  • Entry Level Position, High School/GED and one year experience, and or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Willing to learn and development a career in the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry.
  • Capable to read, understand and execute instructions in basic site procedures.
  • Additional Skills/Preferences:
  • Associate Degree of Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences and previous experience preferred.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.
  • Strong Organizational skills and the ability multi-task across various projects and activities.
  • Must have good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Must be able to obtain and to maintain multiple technique proficiencies (as dictated by site ad business needs).
  • Complete all training, written exams and certifications.
  • Flexible to work on any shift temporarily as business need dictate.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in a GMP environment
  • Quality Control experience in a pharmaceutical industry



PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Must be able to lift a minimum of 30lbs

The position will require lifting, bending, and standing for periods of time, use of ladders and working within controlled environments.


NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

Must not have Penicillin allergy.

Minimal travel for training/seminars.


Work Location Assignment: On Premise

The salary for this position ranges from $19.18 to $31.97 per hour. In addition, this position offers eligibility for overtime, weekend, holiday and other pay premiums depending on the work schedule and the Company’s policies. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. title: Senior Research Development Officer
description:
Job Title

Senior Research Development Officer

Agency

Texas A&M University

Department

Research Development Services

Proposed Minimum Salary

Commensurate

Job Location

College Station, Texas

Job Type

Staff

Job Description

Our Commitment

Texas A&M University is committed to enriching the learning and working environment by promoting a culture that respects all perspectives, talents & lived experiences. Embracing varying opinions and perspectives strengthens our core values which are: Respect, Excellence, Leadership, Loyalty, Integrity, and Selfless Service.


Who We Are

Research Development Services (RDS) is a unit within Texas A&M University's Division of Research dedicated to advancing research capacity and competitiveness across the university. We partner with faculty, researchers, and stakeholders to support strategic research initiatives, secure external funding, and develop high-impact proposals. Through collaborative expertise, professional development, proposal support, and innovative research services, we help transform ideas into successful research programs that advance scholarship, innovation, and discovery.


What We Want

We are seeking a Senior Research Development Officer to identify and pursue federal contract opportunities that align with the university's research strengths and strategic priorities. This role serves as a key liaison between faculty, university leadership, industry, and federal agencies, leading the development of compliant, competitive contract proposals from opportunity identification through submission. The successful candidate will monitor federal contracting pipelines, recruit and coordinate faculty teams, develop winning proposal strategies, and work alongside investigators to secure high-value federal research awards.


What You Need to Know

Salary: Commensurate with experience.

A cover letter and resume are strongly recommended.

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of training and experience.
  • Four years of experience developing or writing proposals to or for federal, state or private agencies.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience executing both front-end business development/capture strategies (win strategy, teaming, shaping) and back-end proposal management (compliance tracking, schedule enforcement, narrative editing).
  • Deep operational knowledge of FAR/DFARS procurement processes, Broad Agency Announcements (BAAs), Other Transaction Authority (OTAs), and SAM.gov solicitation structures (in contrast to traditional Grants.gov assistance mechanisms).
  • Ability to quickly comprehend complex scientific research across engineering, AI/cybersecurity, microelectronics, and applied sciences, translating it into federal contract deliverables (e.g., SOW, BOE, WBS).
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with a proven track record of managing cross-functional teams of academic faculty, corporate partners, and executive university leadership under tight deadlines.
  • Association of Proposal Management Professionals (APMP) certification (Foundation/Practitioner) or Shipley Capture/Proposal Management training.
  • Minimum of 5–7 years of direct experience in research development, business development, capture management, or proposal management within defense, or civil federal contracting.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Ability to multitask and work cooperatively with others.
  • Knowledge of word processing, spreadsheet, and database applications.
  • Oral and written communication skills.
  • Organizational skills.
  • Ability to independently make decisions.

Essential Duties/Tasks

Proposal Development and Management

  • Serves as the end-to-end proposal manager for complex, high-value contract bids.
  • Establishes proposal schedules, compliance matrices, Work Breakdown Structures, and storyboarding sessions.
  • Translates complex technical/scientific capabilities into compliant, compelling proposal sections.
  • Organizes and facilitates formal Red/Pink Team mock reviews.
  • Coordinates with internal stakeholders (Export Control, Research Security, IT) to ensure compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR/DFARS) clauses, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) rules, CMMC cybersecurity standards, and NSPM-33 mandates.
  • Leads responses to agency requests for information (RFIs), Best and Final Offers (BAFOs), and oral presentations.
  • Facilitates seamless handoffs to post-award administrative teams upon award.

Program Oversight and Communication

  • Proactively monitors SAM.gov, agency roadmaps, and BAA releases (e.g., NSF TIP, DARPA, ARPA-H, DOE) to evaluate prospective contract opportunities against university capabilities and strategic growth goals.
  • Defines and executes a comprehensive capture plan for selected opportunities.
  • Develops win themes, competitive analysis, risk mitigation strategies, and university discriminators.
  • Assists Principal Investigators (PIs) in cultivating relationships with agency Program Managers.
  • Coaches PIs on constructing and delivering Quad Charts, White Papers, and Heilmeier Catechism pitches.
  • Identifies, selects, and facilitates non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) and teaming arrangements with industry prime contractors, subcontractors, federal labs, and peer academic institutions.
  • Leads internal "Bid/No-Bid" gate reviews with university leadership to evaluate opportunity alignment, cost-share requirements, and resource allocation.

Research Resources and Tools

  • Develops tools, templates, and guidance documents related to proposal development.
  • Creates, manages, and updates standard information needed to support successful funding applications.
  • Monitors various media sources for relevant new funding and program initiatives and circulates announcements accordingly.

Training and Professional Development

  • Creates and delivers informational sessions on contract-based funding opportunities and proposal development.
  • Assists with training activities to improve investigators' knowledge in federal contracts.
  • Systematically publicizes internal and external professional development opportunities for researchers.

Why Texas A&M University?

We are a prestigious university with strong traditions, Core Values, and a community of caring and collaboration. Amenities associated with a major university, such as sporting and cultural events, state-of-the-art recreation facilities, the Bush Library and Museum, and much more await you. Experience all that a big city has to offer but with a reasonable cost-of-living and no long commutes.

  • Medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, life and AD&D, flexible spending accounts, and long-term disability insurance with Texas A&M contributing to employee health and basic life premiums
  • 12-15 days of annual paid holidays
  • Up to eight hours of paid sick leave and at least eight hours of paid vacation each month
  • Automatic enrollment in the Teacher Retirement System of Texas
  • Health and Wellness: Free exercise programs and release time
  • Professional Development: All employees have access to free LinkedIn Learning training, webinars, and limited financial support to attend conferences, workshops, and more
  • Educational release time and tuition assistance for completing a degree while a Texas A&M employee
  • Living Well, a program at Texas A&M that has been built by employees, for employees

All positions are security-sensitive. Applicants are subject to a criminal history investigation, and employment is contingent upon the institution’s verification of credentials and/or other information required by the institution’s procedures, including the completion of the criminal history check.

Equal Opportunity/Veterans/Disability Employer.

title: Program Manager – DOE National Laboratory Programs
description:
AECOM seeks an experienced Program Manager to lead multidisciplinary teams delivering complex engineering, design, and infrastructure projects for U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) national laboratories and specialized nuclear research facilities. The successful candidate will provide overall program leadership, technical oversight, client relationship management, and contractual and financial accountability for projects supporting nuclear research, fusion energy, and specialized laboratory facilities.

The candidate may work within the cities listed in the posting but will be expected to travel to DOE facilities periodically, including for extended periods as required to support program execution.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as AECOM's primary program leadership contact, providing overall management of program scope, schedule, budget, staffing, quality, and contractual performance
  • Direct multidisciplinary engineering teams and specialized technical subcontractors across structural, mechanical, electrical, process, instrumentation and controls, and nuclear engineering disciplines
  • Oversee technical work involving nuclear safety-related systems, radiological ventilation, structural design, process systems, and instrumentation and controls, ensuring compliance with DOE orders, NQA-1 requirements, and applicable federal regulations
  • Manage project financial performance, including budgets, forecasting, invoicing, cash flow, and profitability
  • Coordinate Documented Safety Analyses, commercial grade dedication processes, procurement specifications, and technical reviews
  • Establish and maintain qualified Key Personnel and designated alternates throughout the contract period
  • Develop technical approaches, staffing plans, schedules, and cost estimates for task order proposals
  • Support laboratory modernization, infrastructure renewal, and operational readiness while maintaining mission continuity during facility upgrades
  • Build and maintain effective relationships with DOE, national laboratory leadership, federal contractors, and industry partners to identify opportunities for program growth and business development
  • Mentor and develop technical and project management staff to support long-term program continuity and introduce innovative engineering methods and digital tools

Minimum Qualifications:

  • BA/BS in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline plus ten years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including two years of leadership
  • Experience with federal government contracting, project controls, financial management, and quality assurance programs including DOE facility requirements, nuclear safety practices, and applicable engineering standards

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary engineering teams and projects of comparable scope and complexity
  • Direct experience working with DOE national laboratories or other nuclear and fusion research facilities
  • Experience managing engineering services under DOE Basic Ordering Agreements or IDIQ contracts
  • Familiarity with DOE-STD-3009-2014, NQA-1, and commercial grade dedication requirements
  • Experience with nonreactor nuclear facilities, radiological systems, hot cells, and remote handling equipment
  • Experience supporting operating research laboratories where mission continuity and safety are critical
  • Established relationships within the DOE national laboratory community
  • Demonstrated success expanding existing federal programs and developing new task order opportunities
  • Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
  • Relocation is not available for this position.
  • THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY January 16, 2027.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. title: Backend Software Engineer | Telia Play
description:
We’re looking for a mid-level to senior Backend Software Engineer to join us at Telia Play.


I’m Tomas Brimor, Engineering Manager at Telia Play, and I’m searching for someone ready to grow with us. We’re a small, supportive, forward-thinking backend team of around 6–8 engineers focused on building and operating the metadata platform behind the viewing experience for nearly 2 million subscribers across the Nordics. We work extensively with AI-assisted development and are building agentic AI in production. These are agents that work with our real services and workflows, not just prototypes.


What you’ll do:

You’ll help decide how solutions are built, from design through production. Our platform assembles complete, accurate records from many partial sources and processes nearly half a million events daily, with peak days exceeding 2 million.

  • Build and evolve our metadata platform, from ingestion and enrichment to APIs and near real-time distribution.
  • Own solutions end to end: understand the problem, shape the approach, implement, test, deploy, and keep improving them in production.
  • Contribute to technical decisions, balancing delivery, reliability, security, cost, and maintainability.
  • Work across backend services and AWS infrastructure, including deployment pipelines, runtimes, and observability. We follow "you build it, you run it", with support from teammates and specialist cloud/DevOps colleagues. On-call is available for those who want it but is not required.
  • Build agentic AI capabilities for our platform and workflows, and make them reliable, secure, and useful in practice.
  • Use AI-assisted development throughout your work, applying your engineering judgment to validate the results and owning what you ship.

Our stack is mainly Kotlin (with some Java) and Spring Boot, with Python for our agentic AI work. We run on AWS with Terraform, SQL/NoSQL databases, SNS, SQS, and Kinesis. You don’t need experience with every part, but you should be comfortable learning beyond your immediate area of expertise. As you learn the platform, your scope and technical influence can grow across backend, cloud, and AI.


What will help you thrive in this role:

You enjoy taking solutions from idea to production, have an ownership mindset, and care how software behaves after deployment, including working with infrastructure, observability, and troubleshooting.


  • Solid experience building and maintaining production backend systems, ideally in Kotlin or Java.
  • A good understanding of APIs, databases, distributed systems, testing, and secure development, with sound judgment about when a straightforward solution is best.
  • An ownership mindset: you care how software behaves after deployment and are happy to work with infrastructure, observability, and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on, critical use of AI-assisted development, and an interest in connecting AI capabilities with real systems in production.
  • Fluency in English, with clear communication and a collaborative approach to discussing trade-offs, solving problems, and sharing knowledge

Experience with AWS, event-driven architectures, and infrastructure as code is a plus, as is experience integrating LLMs, building agents, or operating AI-enabled systems. You don’t need to be an AI specialist. You also don’t need to tick every box: we care about your engineering foundation, sound judgment, and ability to follow through, not an exact match against every technology.


Join us to shape smarter living for people, businesses, and the planet


At Telia, we’re a team of 15 000 colleagues across the Nordics and Baltics, passionate about technology and connectivity. As a Leading Telecommunications Operator & Climate Leader, we drive change with large-scale, impactful projects while building a sustainable, inclusive world.

Here, you can grow your skills, lead meaningful projects, and thrive in a supportive, diverse environment. Whether you’re taking your first step or your next, Telia is a place to grow, belong, and make a real impact.


What we offer

When you join us, you'll receive a comprehensive benefits package tailored to your local market, opportunities for remote work, and more. You'll also have the chance to earn a bonus based on your performance and Telia's results.


Ready to make better happen?

We look forward to receiving your application by 10th of November. Please note that we might close the position earlier if we find the right candidate, so don’t wait too long to apply!

If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our Talent Acquisition Partner. Background and reference checks will be part of the process.

Want to know more about this role? Please reach out to Tomas Brimor at tomas.brimor@teliacompany.com.

Equal opportunities

At Telia, we recognize talent by professional skills and growth potential. We champion diversity, ensuring every individual’s needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where your uniqueness is our strength.


Join us and let’s make better happen - together!

title: Group Leader - Immune Reset
description:
Use Your Power For Purpose

As an Associate Research Fellow at Pfizer, you will play a pivotal role in advancing our mission to improve patients' lives. You will be at the forefront of scientific innovation, contributing to groundbreaking research that has the potential to transform healthcare and bring hope to millions of patients worldwide. Research and Development is at the heart of fulfilling Pfizer’s purpose as we work to translate advanced science and technologies into the therapies and vaccines that matter most. Whether you are in the discovery sciences, ensuring drug safety and efficacy or supporting clinical trials, you will apply cutting edge design and process development capabilities to accelerate and bring the best in class medicines to patients around the world.


The Inflammation and Immunology Research Unit is seeking an accomplished Scientist to lead a new Immune Cell Reset Group within the I&I Discovery team in Cambridge, MA. This role will provide scientific, strategic, and people leadership for a multidisciplinary team advancing innovative cellular depletion approaches for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. The successful candidate will have a strong track record in drug discovery, spanning target identification and validation through candidate nomination, with preferred expertise in preclinical assay development, mammalian genetics, systems biology, and the biological architecture of autoimmune, inflammatory and fibrotic disease. Experience leading programs using antibody, multispecific, ADC, TCE, or other innovative immune cell–depleting modalities is essential. The candidate must have experience collaborating effectively across discovery biology, translational sciences, pharmacology, safety, systems immunology, and other platform groups, while establishing productive external collaborations with leading academic investigators and key opinion leaders. A strong publication record and demonstrated experience managing and developing bench-based scientists are perferred.

How You Will Achieve It

  • Lead the Immune Reset Group within the I&I RU - Discovery. Responsible for refining the strategy and biology focus within this area to support and advance the portfolio.
  • Provide biology expertise to internal teams that helps pave the way for next-generation therapies that leverage cell depletion approaches to develop next generation therapies for rheumatological, dermatological, gastroenterological, neurological, and respiratory diseases.
  • Core member of the Discovery Leadership Team, to support advancement of Immune system reset biology and selective cell depletion approaches into the drug discovery pipeline.
  • Proven experience in managing, growing and developing highly talented scientists.
  • Drive performance by Leading from the Bench. Including the ability to design and execute on key experiments to inform decision-points (GO / NO-GO) at critical stages of projects.
  • Help develop and execute a visionary drug development pipeline in alignment key scientific objectives in discovery immunology research.
  • Highly collaborative, team-oriented, and considerate of the needs of others.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate with diverse groups within the organization and external partners.
  • Highly organized & self-directed, capable of leading multiple complex research programs in parallel.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication is required as well as critical evaluation and data-driven decision making.
  • Provide expert advice and share knowledge with direct reports, peers, and senior leadership.
  • Establish and manage external collaborations with leading research labs around the world. Includes attendance / presentation at conferences and submission of publications.

Qualifications

Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)

  • Excellent academic training with a PhD, MD or MD/PhD equivalent degree(s).
  • 5+ years of related work experience in academia, biotech or pharma.
  • Proven track record of developing, leading and influencing early-stage discovery programs.
  • Deep immunology expertise, with emphasis on understanding how cell depletion approaches canpotentially raise the treatment ceiling for patients with autoimmune disease.
  • Extensive experience in Immunology drug discovery within a high-caliber research environment such as biotech or pharma.
  • Ability to create an inclusive environment where diverse ideas, viewpoints and backgrounds are valued.
  • Demonstrated commitment to developing talent, fostering inclusion, and creating a high-performing team culture grounded in scientific excellence, rigor, integrity, and Pfizer values.

Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated ability to work with teams, establish and cultivate networks, and maintain productive and congenial collaborations.
  • Personnel management experience in coaching and mentoring junior scientists and in generating motivation and passion in a team.
  • Experience using common AI tools, including generative technologies such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, to support problem solving and enhance.
  • Willingness and ability to lead inclusively and demonstrate a commitment to listen and consider all points of view.
  • Ability to work, influence, lead and deliver results in cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent written, presentation and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to be effective in a highly collaborative environment. Several first or senior author publications in high impact journals
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted, productive relationships across multidisciplinary teams and functions, including biology, translational sciences, pharmacology, safety, systems immunology, platform technologies, clinical partners, and external collaborators.
  • Strong learning agility, with the ability to rapidly assimilate complex scientific, technical, and strategic information; identify the essential issues; and adapt direction based on emerging data, portfolio priorities, or business needs.
  • Scientific curiosity and a continuous-improvement mindset, with a track record of challenging assumptions, raising scientific standards, and advancing innovative approaches beyond the status quo.
  • Proven ability to lead with accountability, sound judgment, and data-driven decision-making in a fast-paced discovery research environment.
  • Effective communicator and collaborative leader who can influence without authority, align diverse stakeholders, and clearly articulate scientific rationale, risks, and recommendations to project teams and senior leaders.

· Note: Hiring Manager to include tools, models and system examples based on the specific requirements.


Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.


Work Location Assignment: This is a hybrid role requiring you to live within commuting distance and work on-site an average of 2.5 days per week.


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $162,900.00 to $271,500.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 20.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. title: Technical Architect
description:

In this senior advisory role, you will shape best practices, collaborate directly with our Product and Engineering teams, and provide hands-on guidance for our most complex, strategic services engagements. You will serve as the technical voice of services delivery across Support, Sales, Product Management, Services, and Engineering — helping Intapp deliver outcomes that matter to the world's leading professional firms.




What you will do:


As a Technical Architect at Intapp, you can expect to:


  • Develop and maintain best practices and knowledge-sharing frameworks for implementing Intapp products, driving consistency and quality across services delivery teams
  • Collaborate with delivery teams across business units to design implementation plans for engagements that span multiple product segments
  • Create templates, fixed-scope packages, and technical improvements for common configurations in product applications and integration services
  • Advise and consult on strategic or complex services projects, including hands-on technical implementation work where needed
  • Engage technical and business stakeholders to articulate architectural vision and guide Product and Engineering teams in defining client solutions




What you will need:


Intapp is looking for intellectually curious, self-motivated professionals who like to get hands-on to contribute to the overall success of the business and their team. To apply for this Technical Architect role, you will ideally have:


  • 10+ years of experience in the SaaS industry, with extensive experience implementing enterprise software architecture and technologies
  • Technical architecture experience designing and implementing complex enterprise applications in B2B domains
  • 5+ years of experience in LegalTech or FinTech
  • 2+ years of hands-on implementation experience using data integrations with BOOMI (preferred)

What you will gain at Intapp:


At Intapp, you'll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You'll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that's connected yet flexible and where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities. description:

Bargaining Unit: NON-UNIONDepartment/Location: High Schools

Function / Position Summary
The Athletic Trainer ensures that all student athletes are healthy and safe as they participate in extracurricular and interscholastic athletic events. Certified Athletic Trainers are healthcare providers who specialize in the prevention, assessment, treatment and rehabilitation of injuries while ensuring our student athletes receive the utmost care and consideration.

Job Duties / Responsibilities

  • Work effectively with the local physical therapy team and the physician providing collaborative care in the best interest of the athlete to ensure a safe return to the sport.
  • Build and maintain relationships throughout the community that allow ease of access and streamlining of care for athletes.
  • Maintain strong professional relationships and communication with the school Athletic and Activities Director, physicians, coaches, and parents.
  • Showcase a desire to connect with athletes in a respectful, positive manner
  • Provide medical care for home interscholastic practices and competitions, as well as all away varsity football games. The Athletic Trainer and Athletic Director will determine medical care of home interscholastic practices. Coverage will be based upon injury risk, frequency, and severity.
  • Assist coaches with the development of conditioning and injury prevention programs.
  • Provide initial evaluation of injuries to interscholastic athletes and initiate proper medical follow-up for athletic injuries, including following the concussion protocol and utilizing district software to conduct baseline testing and follow up testing if needed.
  • Design and implement rehabilitation programs for injured interscholastic athletes.
  • Make decisions concerning the return of athletes to practice and competition after injuries.
  • Maintain knowledge of current advancements in evaluation, rehabilitation, and health related aspects of sports medicine.
  • Apply protective bracing, taping, and/or padding when appropriate.
  • Provide educational and emotional counseling for injured interscholastic athletes.
  • Assist coaches with the collection of emergency information for all in-season interscholastic athletes.
  • Work with the Athletic Director to schedule all physician coverage for home varsity football games.
  • Maintain ongoing communication with local physicians in order to expedite the appointments for interscholastic athletes.
  • Consult on the selection and purchase of protective equipment and supervise the fitting of football helmets.


Education

  • At minimum a Bachelor's Degree from CAATE accredited institution
  • Valid ATC Certification: Maintain current certification and continuing education requirements as set forth by the National Athletic Trainers' Association Board of Certification


Experience / Knowledge

  • Ability to read, write and speak English proficiently
  • CPR, First Aid, and AED Certified
  • Driver's License in good standing
  • Professional
  • Energetic and a team player
  • Able to demonstrate compassion toward patients
  • Complete tasks thoroughly and timely
  • Service oriented
  • Strong interpersonal skills and positive problem solving attitude


Physical Demands

  • Specific vision requirements include the ability to see at close range, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear
  • Possess the ability to fulfill any office activities normally expected in an office setting, to include, but not limited to: remaining seated for extended periods of time to perform computer-based work, participating in filing activity, lifting and carrying office supplies (paper reams, mail, etc.)
  • Frequently required to stand, walk dynamically, sit, use hands to feel, and reach with hand/arms
  • Occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
  • Occasionally be required to push, pull, stoop, kneel, crouch, or work at a low level for assistance with patient care of equipment management
  • Fine hand manipulation (keyboarding)
  • Travel may be required to events and competitions


Terms of Employment

  • This is a 12-month position. Approximately 40 hours per week on a flexible schedule. Hours will be dependent on the schedule of the Athletic Department. Work will typically occur on evenings and Saturday mornings/afternoons.

Self-Help started in 1980 with a focus on economic inequality especially in communities that have faced systemic barriers in building wealth. description:
What You'll Be Doing

Primary responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

  • Efficiently manage promotional projects minimizing the cost to Hargrove by working with the Engineering Resource Leaders to accurately estimate Professional Services man hours to complete the project while achieving the objectives.

  • Successfully managing commercial contract(s) on one or more projects of various sizes, as required. Ensure that invoices are paid in a timely manner, Project Change Notices are processed, monthly Office Earnings Report (OER) is reviewed in the time allotted, and the project(s) plan in Vision is current.

  • Maintaining control of the project by tracking and maintaining discipline performance budget progress, schedule commitments, and quality standards. Understanding and utilizing the project tools that are available for project control.

  • Participating in development of all major technical, cost, scheduling and performance decisions on assigned projects.

  • Familiarity with project scope, specifications, deliverables required by client, and design criteria upon assignment to a project and gaining Hargrove team alignment of schedule and budget in regard to deliverables required. Work with client team to define project scope, goals and deliverables that support business goals in collaboration with stakeholders.

  • Recognizing and communicating scope and design changes promptly by championing the Project Change Notice process and promoting a positive Change Management culture.

  • Leading the effort in building a productive Team both within Hargrove and with the client. Utilize rewards where applicable to recognize outstanding contributions.

  • Coordinating resource requirements with other ongoing project work and insure all parties’ expectations are aligned.

  • Planning and organizing the work of your team. Communicating the plan to your team, the project leadership team and the client. Aligning the expectations of all parties. Conduct weekly coordination meetings with the Team.

  • Maintaining timely and accurate reporting including weekly and monthly reports utilizing a comprehensive action item list.

  • Reviewing engineering documents, vendor submittals, fabrication drawings and other construction submittals for compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, good engineering practice, and project objectives. Project Manager is responsible for ensuring all documentation is reviewed and checked against vendor submittals, specifications, interdiscipline, etc. regardless of resource location.

  • Ensuring that standard project work processes are followed by all team members through all phases of engineering, procurement, and construction.

  • Interviewing discipline leads to maintain up-to-date progress against man hour expended analysis. Project Manager is responsible for overall financial health of each project with the respective discipline leads being responsible for producing the required deliverables within the given budget.

  • Assessing the performance of the project team members through the course of the project, and work with resource leadership to organize a qualified and motivated project team.

  • Ensuring project documentation is properly reviewed and approved by the client.

  • Providing Construction Phase Support, start-up assistance, and response to Requests for Information, as needed.

  • Managing timeliness of client team decision making and package approval.

  • Promoting continuing positive relations with the client building on long term relationships that continue to add additional services.

  • Completing project closeout as required by the client.

  • Effectively and proactively managing the client needs at all stages of the project.

Ideal Background

Education: Bachelor or Master of Science degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical or Civil Engineering from an accredited university is preferred.

Certification: Professional Engineering and/or Project Management Professional (PMP) registration is highly preferred.

Experience: This position requires up to 10 years of relevant experience in engineering and project management.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of the Hargrove project execution procedures.

  • Knowledge and application of company business standards and good practices.

  • Knowledge and application of company engineering standards and project controls tools.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in complex project management.

  • Ability to lead a team to deliver on commitments.

  • A comprehensive understanding of the function of all engineering disciplines, procurement, and construction processes.

  • Ability to manage client relationships in complex situations.

  • Ability to relate easily to others in the business community such as customers, suppliers, contractors, government, professional and trade associations.

  • Ability to clearly communicate expectations and requirements to team members and to structure accountability.

  • Ability to set priorities.

  • Demonstrated leadership ability with team orientation.

  • Coaching and mentoring skills and experience.

  • Excellent listening and communication skills, both verbal and written.

  • Excellent presentation skills.

  • Excellent leadership and organizational skills.

  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to sit, stand, or walk for long periods of time.

Hargrove Culture

We work to create an environment founded on trust, personal integrity, and a “team mentality” so that each person understands the value of their contributions both on a project and company-wide level. We know that each person on our team contributes to the success of our company by pairing expertise and passion to meet and exceed the needs of the clients we serve across the globe.

Preferred Qualifications:

title: Quality Auditor - 1st Shift!
description:
Job Description

Quality Auditor


Department: Quality
Location: Avon, NY
Reports To: Compliance Manager / Quality Manager
Union: Teamsters Local 118

Base Schedule: 6 AM - 2:30 PM Mandated OT as needed

Position Summary

The Kraft Heinz Company is currently seeking a Quality Auditor to work at our food processing facility in Avon, NY. This position is responsible for performing quality assurance activities that support food safety, regulatory compliance, product quality, sanitation verification, and production operations. The Quality Auditor works closely with Operations, Sanitation, and Quality teams to ensure products meet Kraft Heinz standards, customer requirements, and regulatory specifications while supporting a safe and efficient manufacturing environment.


Responsibilities


Essential Job Functions

  • Perform pre-operational sanitation audits and daily housekeeping inspections.
  • Conduct bacteriological and environmental swabbing activities.
  • Verify compliance with HACCP programs and food safety requirements.
  • Monitor metal detector performance and document verification records.
  • Inspect incoming raw materials and ingredients as required.
  • Perform hourly weight control checks utilizing approved systems and equipment.
  • Conduct residual oxygen, gas mixture, seal integrity, and package quality testing.
  • Complete finished product evaluations and case audits.
  • Identify, document, and communicate quality concerns and non-conformances.
  • Place product on hold when necessary and communicate findings to Quality leadership.
  • Enter and maintain component complaint and quality documentation records.
  • Complete required quality, food safety, and traceability documentation.
  • Support regulatory, customer, and internal quality audits.
  • Maintain housekeeping standards throughout the production shift.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and corrective action activities.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

Safety Responsibilities

  • Follow all Kraft Heinz safety policies and procedures.
  • Safely operate testing equipment and associated machinery.
  • Follow Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures as required.
  • Wear and maintain required PPE.
  • Report unsafe conditions, behaviors, and equipment concerns immediately.
  • Support Kraft Heinz's safety-first culture.

Sanitation Responsibilities

  • Verify sanitation effectiveness through audits, inspections, and environmental monitoring.
  • Conduct pre-operational inspections to ensure equipment readiness.
  • Support sanitation compliance and corrective actions when deficiencies are identified.
  • Maintain GMP, food safety, and housekeeping standards throughout the shift.
  • Safely handle sampling equipment, testing supplies, and sanitation materials.
  • Support sanitation verification programs and documentation requirements.

Quality Assurance Responsibilities

  • Ensure finished products and production processes meet Kraft Heinz quality standards.
  • Verify compliance with HACCP, GMP, food safety, and customer requirements.
  • Conduct product inspections, process checks, and quality testing activities.
  • Communicate quality concerns immediately and support corrective action efforts.
  • Complete required quality documentation accurately and timely.
  • Support internal, regulatory, and customer audit requirements.
  • Maintain integrity of quality data and records.
  • Participate in continuous improvement and root cause investigations.

Skills Profile

Technical Skills

  • Quality inspection and auditing
  • HACCP and GMP knowledge
  • Food safety verification
  • Sampling and testing procedures
  • Documentation and recordkeeping
  • Data entry and computer skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Regulatory compliance understanding
  • Problem-solving and troubleshooting

Professional Competencies

  • Teamwork
  • Communication
  • Attention to Detail
  • Accountability
  • Reliability
  • Adaptability
  • Critical Thinking
  • Time Management
  • Safety Awareness
  • Decision Making

Physical Requirements

  • Standing up to 12 hours a day
  • Lifting up to 25 lbs. regularly
  • Occasional lifting of 50-100 lbs. with assistance as necessary
  • Repetitive motion with hands
  • Kneeling
  • Twisting
  • Squatting
  • Reaching above shoulder level
  • Working in hot and cold environments (Lunchables 40°F, Cool Whip 90°F/-35°F, Cold Storage 0°F)
  • Working in loud environments over 85 decibels
  • Able to give and understand instructions and hold conversations in a manufacturing environment as well as an office or classroom setting
  • Must operate a computer and other standard office equipment

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required
  • Strong communication skills
  • Ability to work all shifts, cover vacations, weekends, holidays, and mandated overtime as needed
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Prior manufacturing experience preferred

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior manufacturing experience
  • Food manufacturing experience
  • Quality Assurance or Quality Control experience
  • HACCP, GMP, or food safety experience
  • Experience working in regulated manufacturing environments
  • Experience performing audits, inspections, or product testing

Additional Information

  • Applicants must be willing to work any shift, including weekends and holidays
  • Overtime may be required based on business needs
  • Employees are expected to comply with all federal, state, local, company, safety, quality, food safety, and sanitation requirements
  • Employment offers are contingent upon successfully passing a pre-employment oral drug screen conducted onsite in accordance with company policy
  • Successful candidates must be safety and quality oriented and demonstrate adaptability and teamwork in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

Benefits Overview

In addition to competitive pay, Kraft Heinz offers a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, financial future, and personal well-being, including:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • HRA and Optional Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 401(k) with Company Match and Additional Core Contribution
  • Company-Paid Life Insurance and Short-Term Disability
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Pet Insurance and Voluntary Benefits
  • Maven Family Support Resources
  • Paid Vacation and Holidays
  • Shift Differentials and Overtime Opportunities
  • Growth and Advancement Opportunities

Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements, plan terms, and applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement provisions.


Compensation Overview

  • Starting Pay: $22.69/hour
  • Second Shift Differential: $1.25/hour
  • Third Shift Differential: $2.50/hour

About Us

At Kraft Heinz, we produce some of the world's most recognized and trusted food brands. Our Avon facility is committed to manufacturing high-quality products while maintaining the highest standards of safety, food safety, and employee development. We foster a culture where employees can learn, grow, and build rewarding careers in manufacturing.


Why Join Us

We grow our people to grow our business. Whether you're building your manufacturing career or bringing previous quality experience, you'll have opportunities to develop your skills, contribute to world-class food production, and be part of a team dedicated to continuous improvement, quality excellence, and operational success.


Benefits: Coverage for employees (and their eligible dependents) through affordable access to healthcare, protection, and saving for the future, we offer plans tailored to meet you and your family’s needs. Coverage for benefits will be in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and associated governing plan documents.

Wellbeing: We offer events, resources, and learning opportunities that inspire a physical, social, emotional, and financial well-being lifestyle for our employees and their families.

You’ll be able to participate in a variety of benefits and wellbeing programs that may vary by role, country, region, union status, and other employment status factors, for example:

Avon Plant

title: Master Planner
description:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands

Over het team

Onze producten kenmerken zich door een laag volume en een hoge variabiliteit wat specifieke eisen stelt aan onze supply chain. Dat vraagt actuele logistieke kennis, een heldere visie en veel flexibiliteit om je steeds weer aan nieuwe situaties en behoeften aan te passen. Binnen de Naval organisatie is het team Master Planning verantwoordelijk voor het valideren, aansturen en monitoren van programma’s en opdrachten. De masterplanners zijn verantwoordelijk voor de planning en aansturing van de Supply Chain voor onder meer complete radar systemen en ondersteunende apparatuur, reservedelen en reparaties.


Over jouw toekomstige baan

Als onderdeel van het team van 9 Master Planners binnen de Supply Chain geef je sturing aan de logistieke aspecten van onze projecten vanaf de acquisitiefase tot levering. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het valideren van de haalbaarheid van opdrachten en projecten en je beoordeelt en monitort hierbij de tijdige beschikbaarheid van materialen, middelen en menscapaciteit. Hiervoor werk je nauw samen met het S&OP team, Supply Chain Managers, Project Planners, Manufacturing Planners, Tactical Buyers en verschillende andere collega’s binnen de sales-, projecten-, productie- en inkooporganisatie. Waar nodig initieer je maatregelen om het plan passend te maken.


Je bent medeverantwoordelijk voor de orderacceptatie binnen de Supply chain op basis waarvan je de inkoop- en productieplannen vrijgeeft en de Manufacturing Buyers en Manufacturing Planners aanstuurt. Je bewaakt de voortgang van de plannen en specifiek de te halen milestones en neemt waar nodig maatregelen om bij te sturen. Bij afwijkingen koppel je voor aan de belanghebbenden. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt bij (logistieke) escalaties en calamiteiten. Je neemt verbeterinitiatieven teneinde de supply chain als geheel en de planning discipline specifiek op een hoger plan te brengen.


De belangrijkste taken zijn:

  • Het valideren en accepteren van nieuwe opdrachten en projecten
  • Passend maken en houden van het plan.
  • Continue verbetering van de planningsprocessen en de daarvoor relevante data.
  • Het creëren van overzicht voor diverse stakeholders.

Waarom ben jij een goede match

We zijn op zoek naar een teamplayer die:

  • Een voltooide WO of HBO opleiding, bij voorkeur Technische Bedrijfskunde/Logistiek, heeft;
  • Kennis en ervaring heeft op het gebied van (demand / supply) planning en logistiek;
  • Kennis van en ervaring met het gebruik en de toepassing van ERP systemen (bij voorkeur Oracle);
  • Beschikt over een APICS-CPIM diploma dan wel bereid is deze studie te volgen;
  • Gestructureerd en stressbestendig is, oog voor detail heeft en daarnaast rolvast en proactief is;
  • De vaardigheden heeft om te kunnen omgaan met tegengestelde belangen in een omgeving met vele belanghebbenden;
  • Goed kan luisteren en doorvragen, ook wanneer de boodschap niet expliciet is;
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden heeft en gemakkelijk kan schakelen met verschillende partijen;
  • Goede analytische en conceptuele vaardigheden heeft;
  • Een goede beheersing heeft van de Nederlandse (min C1) en Engelse taal(B1), zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Wat krijg jij er voor terug


  • Een uitdagende baan in een leuk team binnen onze high-tech, innovatieve werkomgeving. Inclusief alle ruimte voor eigen initiatief en goede ideeën.
  • Mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling binnen de organisatie, bijvoorbeeld op technisch, commercieel of internationaal vlak.
  • Waardevolle internationale samenwerkingen met collega’s uit 68 landen.
  • Een comfortabele werkplek in een moderne omgeving, met aandacht voor flexibiliteit en de juiste work-life balance.
  • Werken kan meestal waar en wanneer je wil om je werk zo goed en efficiënt mogelijk te kunnen doen. Binnen Thales implementeren we het hybride werken, waarbij je bijvoorbeeld twee dagen in de week thuis kunt werken als je rol dit toelaat.
  • Een goed salaris, passende reiskostenvergoeding en de mogelijkheid om jaarlijks jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden te personaliseren: je kunt bijvoorbeeld vrije dagen ruilen voor internetkosten, ons fietsenplan, bedrijfsfitness en verhuiskosten.
  • 40 vakantiedagen per jaar.


Interesse?
Voor eventuele vragen kan je altijd contact met opnemen met Victor ter Avest, Talent Acquisition Partner van Thales, via victor.teravest@thalesgroup.com.

Of solliciteer direct door op de link te klikken.

title: Colleague Engagement and Experience Lead
description:
Role Summary


The Collegeville Site Affairs Colleague Engagement and Experience Lead will play a key role in delivering an engaging, connected and high-performing workplace experience for colleagues at the Collegeville, PA campus. Working as part of the Collegeville Site Affairs team, this colleague will help translate site priorities into programs, communications, events and operational initiatives that strengthen colleague engagement, build community and support the effectiveness of the site.


The role will partner across functions and with site stakeholders to plan and execute high-visibility initiatives, coordinate site communications and colleague programming, support recognition and community engagement, and help ensure an effective and consistent experience for colleagues and visitors.


This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role requiring strong program management, communication, relationship-building and execution skills. The successful candidate will be comfortable managing multiple initiatives simultaneously, developing solutions to evolving site needs, and working with colleagues and partners at all levels of the organization.


What You Will Achieve


In this role, you will contribute in the following domains:


Colleague Engagement & Site Culture

  • Support development and execution of the Collegeville colleague engagement strategy and annual programming.
  • Plan and deliver site-wide initiatives that strengthen connection, community, inclusion and colleague experience.
  • Support signature Collegeville programs such as Joyfest, colleague recognition, wellness activities, community-building programs and other site events.
  • Identify opportunities to increase colleague participation and strengthen connection across organizations located at Collegeville.

Site Communications

  • Develop and coordinate clear, engaging communications for Collegeville colleagues across established site communication channels.
  • Create content supporting events, initiatives, recognition programs and important site updates.
  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure communications are timely, accurate and aligned with site priorities.
  • Support leader communications and materials associated with key Collegeville initiatives and events.

Events, Programs & Recognition

  • Manage planning and execution for selected campus-wide events and colleague programs from concept through delivery.
  • Coordinate program logistics, communications, stakeholder engagement, vendors and day-of execution.
  • Support executive and leadership visits to Collegeville in partnership with the broader Site Affairs and site operations teams.
  • Help manage Collegeville colleague recognition programs and associated communications and processes.
  • Develop repeatable processes, planning tools and program standards that improve the consistency and efficiency of site programs.
  • Gather participation data and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities to strengthen future programming.

Site Operations & Workplace Experience

  • Serve as a Site Affairs point of contact for assigned campus initiatives and operational matters.
  • Partner with Workplace Experience, facilities, security, digital/AV, food services and other campus partners to deliver coordinated colleague experiences.
  • Help identify and resolve issues that affect site programs or the colleague experience.
  • Support campus activation efforts and other initiatives designed to make effective use of Collegeville spaces.

Community & External Engagement

  • Support relationships and programs connecting Collegeville with surrounding communities and local organizations.
  • Coordinate selected community engagement, volunteer and partnership activities.
  • Help identify opportunities to strengthen Collegeville's connection to the local community.
  • Coordinate internal stakeholders supporting community-facing programs and events.

Stakeholder & Business Operations

  • Build productive relationships across organizations and functions represented at Collegeville.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams responsible for delivering site initiatives.
  • Develop project plans, timelines, budgets and status reporting for assigned programs.
  • Manage vendors and external partners associated with assigned activities.

Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)


  • Bachelor's degree with 4 years or a Master's degree with 2 years of relevant professional experience in areas such as business operations, communications, colleague engagement, program management, workplace experience, events or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience successfully managing multiple programs or projects involving diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a complex, highly matrixed environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships and collaborate across functions and organizational levels.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to move initiatives from concept through execution.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and respond effectively to changing business needs.
  • Experience using common AI tools, including generative technologies such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, to support problem solving and enhance productivity.
  • Demonstrated curiosity for exploring how these tools can improve outcomes and understanding of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience supporting a large corporate, research, healthcare, life sciences or similarly complex workplace environment.
  • Experience developing colleague engagement, recognition, communications or workplace programs.
  • Experience planning large-scale events or programs involving multiple internal and external partners.
  • Experience managing vendors, budgets and operational processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop new programs and continuously improve existing ones.



PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Able to lift up to 25 pounds independently
  • Able to walk up to 3 miles across campus daily
  • Able to stand for prolonged periods

NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

Must be available for in-person support on campus as needed (2-5 days/week)


Work Location Assignment: This is a hybrid role requiring you to live within commuting distance and work on-site an average of 2.5 days per week or more as needed.

description:
OBJECTIVE OF THE OFFICE/DEPARTMENT

This is a requisition for employment at the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO)/Regional Office of the World Health Organization (WHO)

Contractual Agreement:

Non-Staff - International PAHO Consultant

Off Site

PURPOSE OF CONSULTANCY

Background
The Pan American Health Organization World Health Organization Office for Barbados and the Eastern Caribbean Countries is supporting implementation of a regional Pandemic Fund project from January 2025 through March 2028. The project benefits six Member States of the Organisation of Eastern Caribbean States: Antigua and Barbuda (ATG), Dominica (DMA), Grenada (GRD), Saint Kitts and Nevis (KNA), Saint Lucia (LCA), and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines (VCT). PAHO WHO is implementing the project in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the World Bank.

The project seeks to strengthen national and regional capacities for pandemic prevention, preparedness, and response through three interrelated result areas: laboratory systems; early warning and disease surveillance; and human resources for health. Together, these investments are intended to improve the detection, monitoring, and response to public health threats and support more resilient, integrated health systems across the Eastern Caribbean.

During the first year of implementation, participating countries advanced several priority activities. Achievements included deployment of automated antimicrobial resistance diagnostic platforms; completion of multi-hazard preparedness plans; biosafety assessments; regional critical care and infection prevention and control training; certification of health workers; and establishment of District Health Information Software 2 (DHIS2) surveillance systems supported by long-term technical arrangements.

The second and third years of implementation will focus on accelerating delivery and financial execution across a complex portfolio of procurement, technical assistance, and system-strengthening activities. Priorities include laboratory information systems, expansion of DHIS2 surveillance modules, health information system interoperability assessments, biosafety standard operating procedures, One Health coordination mechanisms, and human resources for health registries.

Given the scale, technical breadth, and multi-partner nature of the programme, PAHO WHO requires dedicated support for programme management, donor reporting, digital health coordination, procurement monitoring, budget analysis, and results tracking across the six countries.

Objective
The overall objective of this consultancy is to strengthen programme management, implementation monitoring, donor reporting, and digital health coordination capacity for the Pandemic Fund project across the six ECC countries. Specific objectives are to:

Scope of Services
Under the guidance of Dr. Prabhjot Singh, Advisor for Health Surveillance, Disease Prevention and Control, the consultant will perform the following functions:

• Provide structured programme management support, including maintenance of a consolidated activity and procurement tracking system across all six countries and three implementing entities.
• Support the drafting of mandatory Pandemic Fund reporting products, including quarterly progress reports and the Annual Progress Report due in June of each year.

• Track and document the implementation of digital health activities including DHIS2 module deployments, LIS decisions and procurement, HMIS interoperability roadmaps, and health data governance work across all ECC countries and territories.

• Support coordination with delivery partners (Open Solutions, Filoi Private Limited, University of Oslo, Caribbean Society for Biosafety and Biosecurity (CSBB), Caribbean Med Labs Foundation (CMLF), Global Laboratory and Epidemiology System Strengthening Network (GLESSN), OECS Secretariat, Ross University, Best dos Santos Lab and others) to track contractual milestones, consolidate outputs, and flag implementation risks.

• Support the technical advisor in identifying and addressing bottlenecks in budget execution, procurement timelines, and country-level absorption, drawing on results-based management principles.
