title: Sr Cobra Analyst - LH
description:
At Luminare Health, our people are what set us apart. Their expertise, dedication, and passion for service excellence are the foundation of our success.


We're committed to helping our employees grow through thoughtful development opportunities, meaningful work, and a culture that values collaboration and continuous improvement. When you join Luminare Health, you join a purpose-driven team focused on making healthcare simpler, better, and more affordable.

Job Summary

Job Profile Summary
The Senior COBRA Analyst will be responsible for managing COBRA administration for high complexity clients and their employee’s COBRA benefits, FMLA, retirees and LOA (company leave programs). This position will involve fiscal month end duties, COBRA rate entry and maintenance, COBRA database maintenance and responding to federal/state compliance inquiries.
Job Description
o Fiscal Duties
 Creates monthly disbursement reports for COBRA clients and releases COBRA premiums collected to clients through Accounting department
 Post live checks and lockbox deposit checks daily
 Generates Credit Card payment audits for COBRA team daily
 Processes both monthly and off-cycle refunds
 Processes Automated Clearing House (ACH) forms & recurring credit card payment forms
 Prepares Daily Balancing sheets Maintains data integrity within COBRA database
o Adheres to rate renewal process for COBRA clients
 Analyzes all group renewals, off-anniversary and termination requests for accuracy, reasonability and completeness. Works closely with the COBRA team and other teams when inconsistencies are found
 Inputting renewal rates for clients
 Entry of new client rates with vendor and division set up
 Quality review of inputted rates for rate renewals and new client set up
 Reviews incoming Client Change Request Forms (CCRF) to evaluate COBRA impact
o COBRA Implementation (new clients & terminated clients)
 Participates in implementation calls as COBRA representative
 Gathers all relevant COBRA required information from Implementation team
 Creates new COBRA group in COBRA databased based on information obtained
 Adheres to terminated client process & works with analyst to complete
o Processes COBRA continuation paperwork for COBRA qualified benefits and handling monthly invoicing for these clients as well as account maintenance.
 Processes COBRA Qualifying Events for subscribers and dependents into the COBRA database daily.
 Completes daily auditing process for keyed notifications from the COBRA database daily.
 Completes daily fulfillment of COBRA documentation to subscribers and dependents, adhering to PHI guidelines
o Coordinates and processes all assigned group data related activities with respect to COBRA Administration (including (Federal, State and International), retiree benefit programs & client specific company leave programs.
 Maintains organized files regarding enrollment, termination and changes. Makes sure files contain supporting data necessary to research decisions made on coding variations
 Reports inconsistencies in eligibility, plan structure, account set-ups and systems structure to management. Researches inbound escalations and suggests corrective actions for prevention in future situations. Rebuild of member records in COBRA database as necessary
 Run daily database processing for all input entered the previous day
 Collaborates with internal compliance department to answer inquiries regarding COBRA regulations and Medicare/Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) rules
 Interaction with third party vendors and administrators to update member benefits/coverage
 Provide clients with reporting of enrolled, notified and terminated membership as requested
o Answers overflow of inbound calls through the COBRA queue and independently responds to questions and emails sent to the COBRA email address within standard turnaround time.
o Maintains quality standards for performance
 Meets or exceeds 98% in all aspects of client calls
 Meets or exceed Department of Labor COBRA regulations
o Prepares, updates, and maintains policy and procedure documentation for the COBRA department.
o Train new hire employees and re-train existing employees when required
o Other duties as needed/assigned.

Required Job Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent.
  • 3+ years with COBRA, FMLA, LOA and retiree administration/coordination experience and 3+ years experience with COBRA EAS & PowerStepp
  • Knowledgeable in handling various types of Federal, State andCompany leave programs.
  • Understanding of Administration System processes (premium administration, eligibility, claims, billing, commissions, reporting and premium administration).
  • Customer service experience in a professional setting
  • Knowledgeable in Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook
  • Strong problem-solving ability
  • Must possess strong organizational skills that will allow for multi-tasking
  • Excellent interpersonal skills
  • Positive attitude and willingness to learn

Preferred Job Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • JD Edwards
  • In depth knowledge of COBRA laws, HIPAA portability and eligibility laws
  • Knowledge of Social Security & Medicare law

Location: This position may be performed remotely from anywhere within the continental United States, excluding California, New York, Alaska, and Hawaii.

Function / Position Summary
The Athletic Trainer ensures that all student athletes are healthy and safe as they participate in extracurricular and interscholastic athletic events. Certified Athletic Trainers are healthcare providers who specialize in the prevention, assessment, treatment and rehabilitation of injuries while ensuring our student athletes receive the utmost care and consideration.

Job Duties / Responsibilities

title: Computer Science | Software Engineering internship: dynamic test selection
description:
Introduction

The Pipeline Team within the IT R&D Development Environment department supports more than 5,000 software developers by providing reliable development workflows, automation, and testing solutions. The team maintains a broad range of repositories and automation processes that help developers validate and build software efficiently. As software systems continue to grow in complexity, selecting the right automated tests becomes increasingly important. During this internship, you will help improve a dynamic test selection solution that reduces manual effort, increases testing efficiency, and provides greater transparency in software validation processes. You will contribute directly to improving the development experience for a large engineering community within ASML.


Your assignment

Within software development, automated tests are used to validate code changes before they are integrated into larger systems. Today, many test selections are based on manually maintained test lists. This internship focuses on validating and improving a dynamic test selection approach that automatically identifies relevant tests based on software changes. You will work closely with developers to evaluate, improve, and visualize the selection logic.


Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Extend and improve existing source-to-test matching functionality using Python.
  • Validate the accuracy of dynamically selected tests against actual code changes.
  • Compare dynamic test selection results with manually maintained test sets.
  • Analyze strengths and limitations of dynamic versus static test selection approaches.
  • Gather developer feedback and translate insights into selection improvements.
  • Integrate and evaluate the solution within continuous integration pipeline scenarios.
  • Develop clear visualizations that explain test selections and source-test relationships.

This is a bachelor or master internship for minimum 5 months, minimum 4 days per week (2-3 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of February 2027.


Your profile

To be suitable for the internship, you:

  • Are enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field.
  • Have experience programming in Python.
  • Have knowledge of software engineering principles and automated testing practices.
  • Are proactive, analytical, and comfortable working independently.
  • Communicate clearly in English and enjoy collaborating with different stakeholders.
  • Have an interest in software testing, optimization, and continuous improvement.
  • Enjoy exploring new ideas and developing practical solutions to technical challenges.

This internship is suitable for students who enjoy combining software development, testing, data-driven analysis, and process improvement. You will gain hands-on experience in modern development workflows while helping to improve testing efficiency and automation at scale.


Other requirements you need to meet:

  • You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship, and you are at least 18 years old at the start of the internship;
  • If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement);
  • You attach your cover letter with a clear motivation on why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular;
  • You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your application shows the willingness to relocate.

Function / Position Summary

To facilitate an inclusive school experience that aligns with the Evidence Based Practices for students with disabilities that help foster student interests, independent functioning levels, and individualized needs of students with disabilities and complex learning needs from self contained classrooms in their least restrictive environments (i.e. general education classrooms, Specials and Electives environments). Adhering to published policies and procedures distributed by the federal, state, district, and school administrations is required.

Job Duties / Responsibilities

Confidentiality And Collaboration

  • Attend, as needed, IEP meetings while maintaining full confidentiality of student information in the school and in the community

  • Shares responsibility for maintaining accurate, complete, and correct records as required by law and district policy by:

    1. Implementing assessments of student progress and communicating progress with students and families,

    2. Documenting present levels of academic and functional performance and other relevant special education forms,

    3. Monitoring student records for annual review, reevaluation, and other pertinent dates,

    4. Monitoring that all services included in the most recent IEP are implemented with fidelity, and

    5. Monitoring goals are updated by case managers and/or related service providers for students accessing majority inclusion settings as determined by SST discussions

  • Work collaboratively with the multidisciplinary team (general education teacher, Network Behavior Analyst, Network Teacher Leader, related service providers, etc) to review academic/behavioral data and modify IEP goals accordingly, based on student needs and progress by:

    1. Assisting in implementation plans of BIPs and safety plans in the least restrictive environment

    2. Conducting direct observations and interviews with students and teachers when needed

    3. Organizing and summarizing academic and behavioral data collection as it relates to the inclusive environment

    4. Identifying student supports and recommending adjustments to plans being implemented

    5. Modeling focused intervention practices according to individualized education plans (IEP)

    6. Developing follow-up plans and procedures to improve the school success of students in the inclusive setting while seeking assistance from other professionals, as necessary.

  • Maintains extremely accurate documentation, including contact with students, teachers, and/or parents.

Instructional Support In General Education Setting

  • Assist with environmental adaptations in the general education/Specials/Electives classroom which is in accordance with U-46 Trainings and practices.

  • Collaboratively supports implementation of research-based instructional strategies that account for a range of abilities and cultural backgrounds to ensure building teams are effectively executing interventions that support the academic growth of students coming to in the inclusive setting from a self-contained classroom.

  • Provides support for students and teachers in the inclusive setting by supporting the modification of assignments and assessments in collaboration.

  • Collaborate with related service providers and the general education team to ensure that all IEP goals and accommodations are being implemented with fidelity. This includes behavioral, instructional, and environmental accommodations and supports within the inclusive setting, as well as AAC/communication protocols and procedures.

  • Help support general education teachers with modifying and modeling lesson plans, differentiating assessment materials, and implementing behavior management strategies based off students BIP, within the general education environment.

  • Customize curriculum tools, assessments, and other various gen. ed. instructional resources to promote students to successfully access the general education curriculum. Assist in providing focused intervention practices when needed.

Social/Emotional And Behavioral Support

  • Monitor and help enhance student engagement and performance in the inclusive setting as assigned.

  • Models best practices for colleagues across multiple settings, provides follow-up discussions and supports for teachers, and participates in the planning of systematic interventions and data collection of the students.

  • Collaborates with team members, including parents and outside agencies, when an inclusion student exhibits severe academic and/or social-emotional-behavioral challenges in the school setting.

Job Summary:

The Practice Group Manager will be on site to provide direction, coaching, and support to team members and clinicians in their assigned offices serving as local culture carriers and an extension of operations leadership. They will monitor workflow processes, outcomes, clinician/patient satisfaction and performance measures to ensure their offices are meeting or exceeding the established clinical, operational, and financial objectives set in cooperation with leadership.

title: Software Engineer, AR/VR Device Calibration
location: New Taipei, Banqiao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan
description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.
  • Lead scalable AR/VR device calibration bring-up, factory test automation, and tier-1 vendor turnkey execution across OEM/ODM manufacturing lines.
  • Drive and enforce calibration quality gates, initial T0 dataset validation, and robotic test station qualification across the device lifecycle.
  • Develop and maintain host-to-device calibration software, perception verification pipelines, and automated test frameworks in C/C++ and Python.
  • Diagnose and resolve multi-sensor calibration drift, camera-IMU spatial-temporal misalignment, optical display distortion, and factory station anomalies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional algorithm, embedded firmware, and hardware teams to transition calibration solvers and reference architectures into mass production.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development in C/C++ and Python.
  • 5 years of experience with sensor or optical calibration algorithms (e.g., camera intrinsics/extrinsics, IMU alignment, display distortion) or automated factory test systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with multi-sensor spatial-temporal calibration (e.g., stereo/eye-tracking cameras, 6DoF IMUs, waveguide displays, acoustic arrays) and 3D computer vision geometry (e.g., OpenCV, Eigen, Ceres).
  • Experience deploying and qualifying robotic factory calibration stations, statistical metrology (Gage R&R/GR&R), golden unit correlation, and tier-1 turnkey vendor operations.
  • Experience developing embedded firmware on MCU RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr), Android HAL, or Linux host test tooling (e.g., Rust).

title: Creator Partnerships Strategist & Producer
description:
Join the future of news


We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

The Washington Post is seeking a Creator Partnerships Strategist & Producer to support creator-led branded content programs within WP Studios. This role combines creator partnership strategy with hands-on production, helping identify the right talent for client opportunities and guiding creators from initial outreach through content development, approval and distribution.


The Creator Partnerships Strategist & Producer will support both pre-sale strategy and post-sale execution, partnering with creators and internal teams to develop branded programs that align client objectives with the right platforms, formats, audiences and talent. This role works closely with Creative Strategy, Video Production, Program Management and Business Affairs, and will serve as a primary partner to creators throughout the campaign lifecycle, helping ensure content is strategically sound, on brand and delivered on time.


What Motivates You

  • You are excited by the evolving creator economy and enjoy identifying talent who can authentically connect brands with audiences.
  • You enjoy building creator partnerships that balance client objectives, audience needs, platform dynamics and strong creative ideas.
  • You are energized by working directly with creators and helping turn an initial concept into compelling, high-quality branded content.
  • You enjoy combining strategic thinking with hands-on production and seeing programs through from pitch to execution.
  • You are curious about social platforms, audience behavior, creator trends and emerging formats and use those insights to strengthen your recommendations.
  • You thrive in collaborative environments where creative, production, business and client considerations must come together to deliver successful work.
  • You value strong relationships and enjoy serving as a trusted partner to creators throughout the lifecycle of a campaign.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Develop creator partnership strategies that align client objectives and KPIs with the right platforms, formats, audiences and talent.
  • Source and vet creators based on their professional experience, industry expertise, audience, platform presence, content quality and campaign fit.
  • Negotiate creator fees, manage campaign budgets and maintain strong creator relationships throughout each partnership.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for creators from initial outreach through content development and posting, providing clear communication and coordination throughout the campaign lifecycle.
  • Guide creators through project briefing, scripting and revisions to ensure content remains on brand, responds to client feedback and is delivered on time.
  • Partner with Creative Strategists to develop creator recommendations and proposal materials for RFP responses and proactive pitches, supported by audience insights, platform best practices and industry trends.
  • Create sales materials and case studies that demonstrate WP Studios' creator and social capabilities.
  • Coordinate client review and approval and support the organic and paid distribution of creator content across social platforms.
  • Partner with Video Production, Program Management and Business Affairs to bring creator-led branded programs to market.
  • Use creator discovery and trend tools to identify talent, track industry developments and inform campaign decisions.
  • Maintain an up-to-date database of vetted creators, including professional experience, industry expertise and highest-performing platforms.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience sourcing, evaluating and developing partnerships with creators for branded content, social media or digital campaigns.
  • Experience guiding creators or talent through content production, including briefing, scripting, feedback and revisions.
  • Experience developing creator, social media or branded content strategies based on client objectives, audiences, platforms and campaign goals.
  • Experience working directly with creators, clients and cross-functional creative or production teams throughout campaign development and execution.

title: Salesperson
description:
Job Description

What is a Salesperson?

Entry level sales position capable of supporting the DIY business and achieve our sales and service objectives. The role has good knowledge of store systems, basic automotive system knowledge and basic part knowledge. The role has the basic ability to source from stores, hubs, pdq, and external suppliers. The role has in-depth knowledge of the store inventory and maintenance processes. Position can be part time or full time. Fleet safety certification preferred.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent selling experience for DIY customer visits and phone calls
  • Achieve personal sales goal and help store achieve its sales goals
  • Provide DIY services including battery installation, testing, wiper installs, etc.
  • Maintain store product and operational standards
  • Responsible for inventory processes including truck put away, shoot outs, cycle counts, Back stock, etc.

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Store Cleanliness including floors, bathrooms, facing, dusting, parking lot
  • General stocking including truck stocking and back stock
  • Safely deliver parts to customers as needed

Success Factors

  • Basic driving and navigation ability
  • Ability to use delivery board system
  • Friendly communication
  • Ability to locate and stock parts
  • Safety knowledge and skills
  • Operating inventory systems and store equipment
  • Parts and automotive system knowledge skills
  • Operating POS and Parts lookup systems
  • Expert at testing and diagnostic equipment for DIY service

Essential Job Skills Necessary for Success as a Salesperson

  • Speak and write English (Spanish a plus); communicate effectively and build strong relationships with customers, peers and management
  • Read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, parts catalogs, and procedure manuals
  • Use basic math accurately: add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals
  • Ability to work an assortment of days, evenings, and weekends as needed

Prior Experience that Sets a Salesperson up for Success

  • 2-3 years of successful sales experience in a diverse retail environment, providing superior customer experiences

Physical Demands

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will predominantly be walking or standing. The employee is required to be able to talk and hear, and use hands and fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is usually working inside; however, they will occasionally be outside and exposed to various weather conditions while performing such tasks as installing batteries and wiper blades. The employee is also occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; risk of electrical shock; explosives; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

title: Servicemonteur Warmtenetten (tijdelijke functie)
description:
Als Servicemonteur ben jij hét gezicht van Veolia voor onze particuliere klanten die zijn aangesloten op de stadsverwarming van onze opdrachtgever. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten altijd kunnen rekenen op een stabiele en comfortabele warmtevoorziening.

Vanuit huis vertrek je met een volledig uitgeruste servicebus en ga je aan de slag met onderhouds- en storingswerkzaamheden. In de zomer werk je veel aan preventief onderhoud, terwijl de wintermaanden jou uitdagen ook veel liggen in het oplossen van storingen, zoals lekkages, problemen met slimme meters of het vervangen van complete afleversets. Geen dag is hetzelfde.

Ondanks het zelfstandige karakter van de functie sta je er niet alleen voor en heb je natuurlijk voldoende fijne collega's om je heen om advies aan te vragen en te geven.

Jouw uitdaging als Servicemonteur Warmtenetten

  • Oplossen van storingen en het uitvoeren van onderhoud bij particulieren en verdeelstations;
  • Handelen naar de wensen en behoeften van de klant;
  • Herkennen van terugkerende werkzaamheden om de storingsfrequentie te verlagen;
  • Administreren van je werkzaamheden.

Voor deze functie breng jij het volgende mee:

  • Bij voorkeur een afgeronde technische vakopleiding op mbo-niveau;
  • VeWa certificaat is verplicht;
  • Ervaring als monteur in de installatietechniek of aantoonbare kennis van de aanleg en reparatie van water- en gasleidingen, cv-ketels, pompinstallaties of vergelijkbare technische systemen.
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden, jij bent ons visitekaartje;
  • Neemt deel aan consignatiediensten.

Aanvragen van een VOG kan onderdeel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure.

Wat biedt Veolia jou?

  • Een salaris tussen de € 3.290,- en € 3.888,34 bruto per maand o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband;
  • Een bus tot je beschikking.
  • Een uitstekende balans tussen werk en privé. Je ontvangt 25 vakantiedagen en 13 Adv-dagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;
  • Een aantrekkelijk pensioen, geregeld via het Pensioenfonds PMT, waarbij Veolia 2/3e van het pensioen betaalt;
  • Een korting bij zorgverzekeraars Zilveren Kruis en CZ via onze collectieve ziektekostenverzekering;
  • Een persoonlijk opleidingsbudget en een individueel samengesteld trainingsprogramma. Door de verschillende disciplines binnen Veolia zijn er vele mogelijkheden om door te groeien en om jezelf te ontwikkelen binnen jouw eigen vakgebied;
  • De kans om mede-eigenaar te worden van het snelgroeiende Veolia. Wij hebben een aantrekkelijk programma om aandelen te kopen;
  • Een zeer actieve personeelsvereniging die regelmatig activiteiten organiseert. Denk aan gezellige trips naar het buitenland of een dagje naar een pretpark met of zonder kids;
  • Als medewerker van Veolia kan jij via Fiscfree.nl diverse producten (zoals een nieuwe fiets, smartphone of laptop) met belastingvoordeel aanschaffen.

Daarnaast betekent werken bij Veolia ook:

  • Boeiende projecten;
  • Fijne collega's;
  • Een goede werksfeer;
  • Jezelf ontwikkelen tot dé specialist die je wilt zijn;
  • Samen met 230.000 Veolia collega's werken we wereldwijd samen aan een betere, duurzame wereld.

Enthousiast?
Solliciteren op deze functie gaat heel eenvoudig via de sollicitatieknop! Wil je eerst meer weten over de functie? Dat kan natuurlijk ook. Bel, WhatsApp of e-mail naar Amber List (Corporate Recruiter) via 06-42706435 / amber.list@veolia.com of stel je vragen aan de afdeling HRM via 020-4469009.

title: Project Planner
description:
Job Title: Project Planner

Location: Plymouth, Devon + Hybrid Working Arrangements

Compensation: £33,900 - £42,400 Depending on Experience + Benefits

Role Type: Full time / Permanent or Fixed Term Contract

Role ID: SF76600

At Babcock we’re working to create a safe and secure world, together, and if you join us, you can play your part as a Project Planner at our Devonport Royal Dockyard site.

The role

As a Project Planner, you’ll have an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing Project Management Office (PMO) supporting the Capital Investment Portfolio. You'll work across complex and high-profile projects, helping to ensure critical programmes are delivered safely, efficiently and on schedule. As part of a collaborative team, you'll gain exposure to a wide range of stakeholders while developing your expertise in project controls, planning and scheduling within one of the UK's most important engineering and infrastructure environments.

Day-to-day, you’ll provide professional planning and scheduling support across a portfolio of infrastructure projects. Working closely with project managers, engineers, construction teams, commercial professionals, subcontractors and supply chain partners, you'll play a key role in coordinating project schedules, monitoring performance and supporting effective project delivery.

  • Supporting Project and Programme Managers with project scheduling and planning activities.
  • Preparing and delivering schedule-related reports, data and project performance information.
  • Maintaining project schedules and ensuring alignment between programme plans and project costs.
  • Assisting with critical path analysis, schedule variance reporting and annual spend forecasting.
  • Collaborating with engineering, construction, commercial and supply chain teams to support project delivery.

This role is full time, 35 hours per week and provides hybrid working arrangements.

Essential experience of the Project Planner

  • Knowledge of project planning, scheduling or project controls principles.
  • Experience developing, maintaining and monitoring project schedules and programme plans.
  • Experience coordinating activities and tracking progress across project teams.
  • Understanding of how cost, risk, estimating and change management interact with project schedules.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.

Qualifications for the Project Planner

Desirable:

  • Experience using Primavera P6 scheduling software.
  • APM Project Planning & Control Foundation (PPC).
  • APM Project Fundamentals Qualification (PFQ).
  • ONC in an Engineering discipline or equivalent technical experience.

Security Clearance

The successful candidate must be able to achieve and maintain Security Check (SC) security clearance for this role.

Many of the positions within our company are subject to national security clearance and Trade Control restrictions. This means that your eligibility for certain roles may be affected by your place of birth, nationality, current or former citizenship, and any residency you hold or have held. Further details are available at United Kingdom Security Vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk).

What we offer

  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Matched contribution pension scheme, with life assurance
  • Access to a Digital GP, annual health check, and nutritional consultations through Aviva DigiCare+
  • Employee shopping savings portal
  • Payment of Professional Fees
  • Reservists in the armed forces receive 10-days special paid leave
  • Holiday Trading is a benefit that allows UK Babcock employees to buy additional leave or to sell up to one working week of annual leave from their annual entitlement. This Window opens February through to March annually.
  • ‘Be Kind Day’ enables employees to take one working day's paid leave a year (or equivalent hours) to undertake volunteering work with their chosen organisation or registered charity

Babcock

We’re Babcock — a global FTSE 100 organisation with over 29,000 people working together to make a difference.

Here, you’ll be part of something bigger. From initial design to final decommissioning, your work will contribute to products and services that are essential to national security and public infrastructure. Together, we’re building a future that lasts — not just through the impact we make, but through meaningful careers that respect your work-life balance.

We call that lifetime engineering.

Join us and see how far we can go, together.

We are a disability confident committed employer. If you have a disability or need any reasonable adjustments during the application and selection stages, please email careers@babcockinternational.com with the subject header ‘Reasonable adjustments requirement’. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone’s free to thrive. We are happy to talk about flexible working – please ask about alternative patterns of work at interview.

title: Restaurant Technician
description:
Job Description:

Onvo is seeking a Restaurant Technician to maintain, troubleshoot, and repair a variety of restaurant equipment and systems, ensuring optimal operational efficiency and guest satisfaction. This role involves both preventative and reactive maintenance tasks across multiple restaurant locations.

Job Responsibilities:

* Perform routine preventative maintenance on kitchen equipment including ovens, fryers, grills, refrigerators, freezers, dishwashers, and other food service machinery.
* Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, and plumbing issues affecting restaurant operations.
* Troubleshoot and resolve problems with HVAC systems, exhaust hoods, and refrigeration units.
* Conduct basic repairs and maintenance on facility infrastructure, such as lighting, plumbing fixtures, and minor carpentry.
* Respond promptly to emergency repair requests to minimize downtime and disruption to restaurant service.
* Order and manage inventory of spare parts and tools necessary for repairs.
* Maintain accurate records of all maintenance activities, repairs, and parts used.
* Collaborate with restaurant managers and staff to understand equipment needs and prioritize repairs.
* Adhere to all safety regulations and company policies during maintenance and repair work.
* Assist in the installation of new equipment as needed.
* Provide basic training to restaurant staff on proper equipment usage and minor troubleshooting.

Job Qualifications:

* High school diploma or equivalent; vocational training or certification in HVAC, refrigeration, electrical, or culinary equipment repair preferred.
* Proven ability to diagnose and repair commercial kitchen equipment, including gas, electrical, and refrigeration systems.
* Strong understanding of electrical circuits, plumbing systems, and mechanical components.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation as travel between Onvo locations may be required.
* Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, schematics, and blueprints.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Physical ability to lift heavy objects, climb ladders, and work in various environmental conditions (e.g., hot kitchens, cold freezers).
* Knowledge of safety protocols and best practices in equipment maintenance.
* EPA Universal Refrigerant Certification is a plus.

title: Head of Data Strategy & Governance
description:
Join Mizuho as the Head of Data Strategy & Governance!4


The Head of Data Governance reports to the Chief Data Officer and leads the implementation of the Enterprise Data Management Framework across Mizuho Americas. This role is accountable for establishing governance and quality standards, ensuring compliance, and driving strategic alignment with business and technology initiatives. The Head of Data Governance acts as a thought leader and change agent, fostering a culture of data stewardship and continuous improvement.


The role requires the candidate to act as influential thought leader bringing in external perspectives on the execution to drive adoption. As a change agent, the candidate will ensure a good understanding of the data vision across the company. The role will focus on defining the long-term data management roadmap, constantly working with business units to identify use cases for data, and then on prioritizing such use cases and coordinate implementation efforts to achieve high-quality and on-time delivery.


Key Responsibilities


Strategic Planning & Implementation


  • Update and maintain the data strategy, ensuring alignment with Mizuho’s business and technology strategies.
  • Support the development and execution of strategic initiatives, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive transformation, efficiency, and innovation.
  • Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies to inform strategic planning and data management practices.
  • Track progress through key performance indicators and report on benchmarks across data management capabilities.

Governance & Controls

  • Own and refresh Enterprise Data Management Policy, capabilities Standards, and Standards of Care.
  • Ensure policies and standards enable the data strategy and support business objectives.
  • Drive alignment and document preparation of reporting, including to the Data Executive Committee and Enterprise Data Council.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Serve as the point of contact for IT GRC, Internal Audit, and Non-Financial Risk teams for capability reviews and assessments.
  • Demonstrate adherence to policies and standards, identify potential risks, and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Oversee internal audits reviews and coordinate reporting on corrective actions as necessary.

Operational Execution

  • Coordinate the definition and assembly of board, head office, and regulatory presentation decks.
  • Manage resource planning, recruitment, and onboarding efforts.
  • Support change management procedures and data governance initiatives.
  • Drive alignment and readiness across capabilities to support production and audit review.
  • Ensure business continuity planning and initiative closure documentation.

Culture & Communication

  • Foster understanding and conviction of the data management vision across the organization.
  • Oversee enhancements and change management responsibilities for Mizuho Data Academy.
  • Manage the EDMO SharePoint site and produce regular communications (e.g.newsletters).
  • Drive collaboration and transparency across departments and leadership teams.

Portfolio & Financial Oversight

  • Manage project portfolios and reporting structures, tracking the book of work roadmap.
  • Oversee financial reporting, vendor relationships, initiative costing, and vendor data cleanup.
  • Coordinate annual planning and budgeting processes, setting and monitoring performance benchmarks

Minimum Qualifications & Skills

  • 15+ years of experience with data, including strategy, project management, and governance.
  • 10+ years in management/executive roles.
  • Strong leadership in enterprise or cross-functional roles.
  • Ability to translate business needs into data needs and draft data roadmaps.
  • Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and drive change in large organizations.
  • Knowledge of enterprise data domains, data products, and operational best practices.


The expected base salary ranges from $200k-$250k. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications and licenses obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to salary and a generous employee benefits package, successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus.

Other requirements

In office attendance is an essential function of this role. There is currently a requirement to be in the office a minimum 50% of the time, or five out of every 10 business days. Specific information about the requirements for your role will be communicated during the recruitment process.

Mizuho Financial Group, Inc. is the 15th largest bank in the world as measured by total assets of ~$2 trillion. Mizuho's 60,000 employees worldwide offer comprehensive financial services to clients in 35 countries and 800 offices throughout the Americas, EMEA and Asia. Mizuho Americas is a leading provider of corporate and investment banking services to clients in the US, Canada, and Latin America. Through its acquisition of Greenhill​, Mizuho provides M&A, restructuring and private capital advisory capabilities across Americas, Europe and Asia. Mizuho Americas employs approximately 3,500 professionals, and its capabilities span corporate and investment banking, capital markets, equity and fixed income sales & trading, derivatives, FX, custody and research. Job Summary

It starts with heart. That is what you will do each day. As an Emergency Department Technician at Monument Health, you can begin your healthcare career with no experience necessary. You will be valued as an essential team member providing compassionate patient focused care. You will discover a culture of teamwork, professionalism, mutual respect, and— most importantly— a life-changing career. You will make a difference. Every day.

As an Emergency Department Tech, you will assist the nursing staff in providing excellent, effective, and safe patient care appropriate to the diagnosis of the patient. Continual support will help build knowledge and skills needed to provide best in class care and demonstrate cohesive teamwork.

Our vision at Monument Health is to be one team, to listen, to be inclusive, and to show we care. To do the right thing. Every time. If you share this philosophy, we hope you’ll join us.

Monument Health offers competitive wages and benefits on qualifying positions. Some of those benefits can include:

*Supportive work culture

*Medical, Vision and Dental Coverage

*Instant pay is available for qualifying positions

*Opportunities for growth and advancement

*Tuition assistance/reimbursement

*Excellent pay differentials on qualifying positions

Job Description

Essential Functions:

  • Contributes to the delivery of patient care in accordance with the patient plan of care, utilizing age specific growth and development guidelines as delegated by the nurse.
  • Demonstrates the ability to identify an emergency situation and initiates appropriate responses.
  • Documents ongoing patient status in the triage log/patient record for patients in waiting/patient room.
  • Monitors and maintains appropriate PAR levels of medical supplies that are both stock and non-stock in patient rooms
  • Participates in admission, discharge and transfer process.
  • Reports immediately any changes in patient status or pertinent patient information to the nurse.
  • Responds in a timely manner to patient/family requests and communicates patient needs to appropriate nursing personnel.
  • Supports activities that promote an efficient and cost effective unit.
  • Supports and assists with patient care activities in collaboration with the nurse/charge nurse.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Additional Requirements

Required:

Preferred:
Experience - 1+ years of Acute Experience; 1+ years of Healthcare Experience
Certification - Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) - National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT)

Scheduling Requirements: Requires the ability to work assigned schedules and hours as determined by the department.

Physical Requirements: Very Heavy work - exerting over 25 pounds of force constantly (67-100% of the time), and/or more than 50 pounds frequently (34-66% of the time), and/or more than 100 pounds of force occassionally (up to 33% of the time), and/or more than 100 pounds of force seldomly to move objects.
